stories.title: BSF jawan dragged 10 metres by tractor:Lies in agony for 25 minutes; flesh strewn on road
stories.summary: In Gorakhpur, an out-of-control tractor-trolley first hit a BSF jawan on Wednesday. Then dragged him for 10 meters, which led to his death. After the accident, pieces of flesh were scattered on the road. For 25 minutes, the BSF jawan kept writhing on the road. During this time, people kept making videos. Then some passersby started taking him to the hospital in an ambulance, but he breathed his last on the way. The BSF jawan was posted in Assam. He had come to his village on leave on April 21. Meanwhile, after the accident, the driver abandoned the tractor-trolley and fled. After the BSF jawan's death, his wife and family members are in a terrible state, crying inconsolably. The police have seized the tractor and started searching for the driver. The accident occurred in the Jhangha police station area. First see 3 pictures... Now read the complete case Pawan (35), who lived in village Belwa of Brahmapur development block, was a BSF soldier. On Wednesday morning at 8 am, Pawan was going to Chaurichaura on his bike. Near Parsauni, a speeding tractor-trolley coming from behind hit his bike with tremendous force. The collision was so severe that Pawan fell on the roadside. Getting caught in the wheels of the tractor-trolley, he was dragged for about 10 meters. This caused his leg to be torn apart. Pieces of flesh were scattered far and wide. Breathing stopped before reaching the hospital After the accident, Pawan was being taken to Gorakhpur with the help of local people. However, his condition continued to deteriorate on the way. He died before reaching the hospital. Pawan's family includes his wife Chanda, son Abhay (5) and daughter Harshita (2). Pawan's wife is in a terrible state, crying inconsolably. Jhangha Police Station SHO Anoop Singh said - The tractor-trolley has been seized and raids are being conducted to search for the absconding driver. The body has been sent for post-mortem after completing the panchnama. A case will be registered under relevant sections and strict legal action will be taken.

stories.title: Woman retracts claim in Mahoba BJP chief allegation case:Says, 'dispute resolved; earlier accused him of pressuring for sexual relations
stories.summary: A female BJP leader from Mahoba had accused the district president of demanding sexual favors in exchange for the position of district vice president. After a 2-member state-level team started the investigation, she made U-turns from her statement 3 times. Now a compromise has been reached between both parties. Deepali Tiwari had said on April 26 that BJP district president Mohan Lal Kushwaha made an immoral demand for the district vice president position. He told her - sleep with me, I will make you vice president. On April 28, she mentioned a compromise before the investigation committee. A short while later, she said - my compromise is only with the party, I still want action against the BJP district president. However, on April 29, she changed her statement again, saying that she has reached a compromise with both the party and the BJP district president. No complaints from the President now - Deepali Former district minister Deepali Tiwari says - Our mutual differences have been resolved. I have no complaints from the President now. There is no pressure on me. I was troubled then, that's why I gave such a statement. I would just like to say that everyone should work together unitedly. Meanwhile, BJP district president Mohan Lal Kushwaha called Deepali his younger sister. He said - Our differences arose due to people spreading confusion. Now read the complete matter Had resigned from district minister post 34 days ago Deepali reached the SP office around 1 PM on Monday afternoon with a complaint letter. She said - I have come to file a formal complaint against Mohan Lal Kushwaha. Deepali said, due to not getting a better position in the party, I had resigned from the district minister post 34 days ago. District president Mohan Lal had shared a letter on social media stating that the resignation was accepted by the party. However, the top leadership says that no official approval has been given for the resignation. Deepali had made 2 demands- Deepali's four major allegations 1. Threatened to put husband in jail Deepali Tiwari had said, I was threatened that your husband would be implicated in a false case and put in jail. That's when I was forced to speak up and come forward. My husband also encouraged me to present my side and not be afraid. Because speaking the truth can also save other women from atrocities. 2. Objectionable demands in exchange for position in organization Deepali Tiwari had said that some time ago a team was formed in the organization. She requested several times to be included in the team and given a big post like District General Secretary or District Vice President. On this, District President Mohan Lal called her. She went to him to present her case. The allegation is that Mohan Lal said to Deepali, 'If I make you district vice-president, you will have to accompany me everywhere - Lucknow, Delhi, everywhere. No one will even suspect. Just sleep with me once. If you agree to what I say, I will also get you a ticket for the district panchayat.' According to Deepali, she was spoken to in hints and told that she is intelligent and should understand everything. She was also told that if she agrees to their terms, she would be given a position. 3. District Panchayat Ticket Proposal Deepali Tiwari had said that she was stunned upon hearing this. What was said was extremely objectionable. She was told to "compromise just once." She replied that you also have sisters and daughters at home, how can such things be said. After this, she started to leave from there. It is alleged that while leaving, she was also told that if she agreed to the matter, she could also be given a ticket for the district panchayat. 4. Pressure through close officials Deepali Tiwari had said that she worked in the organization for 10 years and she did not want her hard work to go in vain. She continued working and kept hoping for justice from the top leadership. But later, Pankaj Tiwari, a close official of Mohanlal, told her that if she agreed to the district president's proposal, she could be made district general secretary. Deepali said that she clearly refused and warned not to make such proposals again. Despite this, questions were raised about her character and comments were made on social media, while no action was taken at the party level. Had Demanded Investigation from SP On April 26, former district minister Deepali Tiwari met with the SP and demanded an investigation. To investigate the matter, the BJP state leadership sent a two-member inquiry team to Mahoba. This team included Women's Welfare Corporation Chairperson and BJP State Vice President Kamlawati Singh along with Regional General Secretary Sant Vilas Shivhare. The team held discussions with both parties in a closed room for about five hours on the evening of April 28. After the meeting, the inquiry committee claimed that the matter had been resolved. However, even after that, the former district minister kept changing her statements repeatedly.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Modi inaugurates Ganga Expressway; West Bengal records 91.3% voter turnout more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Modi inaugurates Ganga Expressway, slams opposition for blocking Women’s Reservation Bill Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated Uttar Pradesh’s longest Ganga Expressway from Hardoi. He planted a sapling along the expressway and also walked on it with Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. 2. Voting ends for West Bengal 2nd phase, 90% voter turnout till 5pm Voting in the second phase for 142 seats in West Bengal has concluded. By 5 pm, 90% voter turnout was recorded. Several incidents of violence, lathi charge, sloganeering, and alleged tampering with EVMs have been reported from multiple assembly constituencies. 3. Massive fire engulfs 7 floors of 15-storey Ghaziabad building A massive fire broke out at Gaur Green Avenue Society in Ghaziabad at around 8:30 am on Wednesday. The fire started on the 9th floor of a 15-storey building and quickly spread to 7 upper floors, with thick smoke visible from some 5 km away. 4. Pakistanis use gas-filled balloons for cooking In Karachi, a severe gas shortage has forced residents to adopt an unusual and risky method of cooking food using plastic balloons filled with gas. According to an ARY News report, daily life in the city is being severely disrupted due to prolonged gas load-shedding and persistently low pressure. 5. 3 women die in road accident in Unnao, 7 others injured Three women lost their lives, while seven others, including several children, were seriously injured in a road accident in Unnao district on Wednesday. The crash was extremely severe, with one woman decapitated and the bodies of two others found in two parts. The incident took place around 10:30 AM near Keeratpur village in the Bihar police station area on the Unnao–Raebareli road. 6. Bareilly woman poses as officer, dupes many with job promises; held A woman in Bareilly allegedly staged a highly dramatic impersonation of an IAS officer after failing to clear the UPSC exam despite five years of preparation in Prayagraj. 7. Trump tells Iran to 'get smart soon' in new warning In a post on social media platform Truth Social, US President Donald Trump warned Iran by saying, No more Mr. nice guy’. In this post, he further mentioned, “Iran can’t get their act together. They don’t know how to sign a non-nuclear deal. They better get smart soon! President DJT” 8. BJP leader Brij Bhushan Singh may join Samajwadi Party again Political circles in Uttar Pradesh are abuzz with speculation that senior BJP leader Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh may switch to the Samajwadi Party (SP). Sources indicate that his talks with Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav are in the final stages, and if all goes well, Singh could appear on the SP platform by September–October. 9. Student death sparks night protest at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University Student death triggers midnight unrest at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University as thousands storm VC residence, break gate, demand action. Students allege that food poisoning and negligence by Yashodhara Hostel authorities and mess management resulted in the death of the student. 10. Sensex jumps 609 pts; Nifty adds 182 pts; auto shares spearhead rally The share market closed on a strong footing on Wednesday, April 29, 2026. The Sensex settled at 77,496.36 level with a gain of 609 points. Nifty also had a gain of 182 points. Today there was more buying in auto, IT and fmcg shares.

stories.title: Groom dies before wedding vows in Shahjahanpur:Collapses at bride’s doorstep after accident a day earlier
stories.summary: The groom died before the seven vows in Shahjahanpur. The groom had been injured in an accident a day earlier. After treatment, when his condition improved, he arrived at the bride's house with the wedding procession. The groom went for the dwarchaar (welcoming ceremony) riding on a buggy. He was unable to walk. Therefore, the women from the bride's side performed the tilak ceremony on the groom while he was on the buggy itself. Somehow the dwarchaar rituals were completed. Preparations were underway to go to the mandap (wedding altar), when suddenly the groom's condition started deteriorating. Family members took him to the hospital. The groom passed away in the early hours of Wednesday. The groom had come with the wedding procession from Bareilly on Monday night. Police handed over the body to the family members after post-mortem. The groom's last rites will be performed in Bareilly. Wedding was on April 27, tractor hit him on the 26th Sanju (25 years old), a resident of Karanpur Shankarpur in the Faridpur police station area of Bareilly, worked in a private job. His wedding was fixed in Rajpuri village in the Tilhar police station area of Shahjahanpur. The wedding was to take place on April 27. Therefore, relatives had started arriving at home two days in advance. Sanju was going on his bike to pick up a relative from Kesharpur around eight o'clock on the night of April 26. On the way, a tractor hit him, which caused injury to his stomach. Family members had admitted him to a hospital in Bareilly. When condition improved, took leave for wedding According to family members, after treatment when Sanju felt improvement in his condition, he took discharge from the hospital. He left with the wedding procession for Shahjahanpur. He had also taken pain medication from the hospital. But after the dwarchaar (wedding ritual), when his condition deteriorated, he could not reach the wedding mandap. He died in the hospital. After Sanju's death, there is mourning in his family. Treatment was ongoing at Bareilly Medical College The groom's cousin Yashpal said, Sanju was very happy about the wedding. Due to the injury, he was unable to walk. He was lifted and made to sit in the buggy. His health started deteriorating from that time onwards. The door ceremony was completed, but after that his condition worsened. We took him to Shahjahanpur Medical College. Where he died.

stories.title: Lucknow HC refuses Sahara Shahar plea:Says, 'case pending in Supreme Court; petition dismissed as not maintainable
stories.summary: The Lucknow bench of the Allahabad High Court has refused to entertain a petition filed by M/s Sahara India Commercial Corporation Limited in connection with the Sahara Shahar land dispute, citing lack of maintainability. A bench of Justices Rajan Roy and Manjive Shukla observed that the issue is already pending before the Supreme Court, where Sahara has filed an application and the Lucknow Municipal Corporation (LMC) has raised objections. The court stated that since the apex court is actively hearing the matter and has passed interim orders, it could not proceed further. “We find our hands tied in proceeding any further in the matter,” the bench noted while dismissing the plea at this stage. Petition challenged lease cancellation orders The petitioner had challenged two orders issued by the Lucknow Municipal Corporation in September 2025—one cancelling the land lease granted to Sahara in 1994, and another directing the company to vacate the land. Sahara argued that an arbitration order passed in its favour in 2017 regarding the same land had been ignored by the corporation. It also submitted that it was willing to deposit the required amount to extend the lease. However, the Municipal Corporation opposed the plea. Link to Supreme Court proceedings During the hearing, the High Court noted that contempt proceedings related to the Sahara–SEBI dispute are pending before the Supreme Court. It was also brought on record that Sahara had moved an application before the apex court in September 2025, seeking permission to transfer certain properties to the Adani Group to raise funds for compliance with court orders. Sahara Shahar was listed among those properties. Considering that the matter is already under active consideration of the Supreme Court, the High Court held that there was no occasion to entertain the present petition separately and dismissed it as not maintainable. Subrata Roy breathed his last at the age of 75 Subrata Roy Sahara had problems of metastatic stroke, high blood pressure and diabetes. He passed away at 10:30 PM on November 14, 2023 due to cardiorespiratory arrest. He was 75 years old at that time. He was admitted to Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital and Medical Research Institute (KDAH) since November 12. Subrata Roy's last rites were performed in Lucknow. Both his sons Sushanto and Seemanto were abroad. They did not attend the last rites. His grandson lit the funeral pyre.

stories.title: Student death sparks night protest at BBAU:Thousands push through VC gate, raise slogans; demand resignation amid campus unrest
stories.summary: Students created chaos at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (BBAU) in Lucknow. They insisted on meeting VC Professor RK Mittal at midnight on Tuesday. When they were stopped, students from the entire university gathered outside the VC's residence. They forcibly opened the closed gate and entered inside. However, the VC was not found inside. He was somewhere outside the campus. This student outrage erupted after the death of Anamika Singh, a first-year student of Integrated Basic Science. Students claim that Anamika had food poisoning after eating hostel food. Her treatment was ongoing in Varanasi for 5 days. She passed away on Tuesday evening. This death occurred due to the negligence of those responsible for Yashodhara Hostel and the mess. See 3 pictures- Female student said - Food in every mess has insects Student Vanshika Chaubey said - Food in every mess here has insects. No complaint was heard anywhere. We complained from the warden to the top level. A 15-year-old girl died just from eating contaminated food. This is not a normal death, it is murder committed by the institution. When we came to raise the issue, security guards were called for us. The guards lathi-charged us. Male security guards came and rained lathis on the girls. The dharna will continue until the VC talks Student Diksha said - Whenever anything happens here, the police arrive within just 10 minutes. During this time, no one from the university administration even comes forward to talk. So far, no one from the university administration has come forward to talk to the students. Until the Vice-Chancellor himself comes and talks, this dharna will continue. Not only is the university food bad, but the water is also contaminated. For 7-8 months, applications have been submitted to the VC requesting that the food here be improved. The water throughout the entire campus remains polluted. When the Proctor is informed about any issue, he arrives 4 hours later. Family members took her to Varanasi after she fell ill Students say that Anamika had taken leave from the university 5 days ago due to ill health and had gone to her home in Varanasi. A student said - Anamika had told her hostel friends that the doctor had attributed her illness to food poisoning. Treatment was ongoing when she died late Tuesday evening. Upon receiving news of Anamika's death, angry university students came out of the hostel and reached the Vice Chancellor's residence, creating a commotion by alleging that bad food was being served in the mess. Within moments, the university administration called security guards. Reporter Pranav Kumar is giving updates till 1 o'clock- Police called to campus, restrictions at VC residence After allegations of male security guards lathi-charging female students at night on the university campus, women police personnel have also been called today. There is strict security inside the campus. Restrictions have been imposed on going to the VC residence. BBAU spokesperson Dr. Rachna Gangwar said that the Vice-Chancellor arrived on campus this morning. He is holding a meeting on an important matter. An official statement regarding this student protest will be issued shortly.

stories.title: 'Mom, I’ve taken poison, save me':Groom dies 2 days after wedding in Gorakhpur; reason remains unclear
stories.summary: In Gorakhpur, on the third day of his wedding, a groom took his life by consuming a poisonous substance. While walking on the terrace at night, when his mother reached him, he said, “I have consumed poison, save me.” Seeing his condition deteriorate, panicked family members rushed him to the hospital, but doctors declared him dead. This Monday incident is from the Shahpur police station area. The youth has been identified as Rudranath. His wedding took place on April 25 with a young woman from Maharajganj. Just a day before, he had brought the bride home. The reason for suicide has not yet come to light. Know the complete case Prem Jaiswal, a resident of Padri Bazaar, has three sons and one daughter. Rudranath Jaiswal alias Minshu (29) was the second one. Rudranath's marriage took place on April 25 with a young woman from Nautanwa in Maharajganj. The wedding was held at a marriage hall in Gorakhpur itself. After the bidai on April 26, the bride came home. According to family members, Rudranath had been very happy since the marriage was fixed. He had done all the shopping according to his own choice. From the sherwani to the turban and dupatta, he had taken matching ones. He was very happy during the garland exchange and the wedding as well. According to his mother, even after the bride came home, he had performed all the rituals happily. There was an atmosphere of joy and celebration in the family. On the third day of the wedding, on April 27, he went to his hotel at Padri Bazaar to help his father. He came home in the evening. After having dinner, he went to his room. Then late at night, he went to the terrace to walk. During this time, his mother came. She asked - why are you walking so late at night? When his mother asked, Rudra told her that he had consumed poison. He was feeling restless. The mother called other family members by shouting. Rudra's condition started deteriorating. He began pleading to save him. People rushed him to the hospital immediately. But doctors declared him dead within a short time. After his death, there was chaos and wailing at home. The newlywed bride and mother became unconscious. The entire family went into shock. Reason for suicide not yet clear After the groom's death, the family members are in a terrible state, crying. Why Rudra committed suicide, the reason has not yet come to light. Meanwhile, after Rudra's death, most shops in the Padari Bazaar area remained closed. The trade association kept shops closed on Tuesday in mourning. The weekly market also did not operate. The reason for suicide is being investigated CO Gorakhnath Ravi Singh said The body was handed over to the family after post-mortem. The family members could not tell the reason for suicide. The matter is being investigated. It will be revealed soon.

stories.title: Failed UPSC aspirant turns fake IAS, cheats job seekers:Dupes people for govt jobs in Bareilly, involves 2 sisters in organised scam
stories.summary: A woman in Bareilly allegedly staged a highly dramatic impersonation of an IAS officer after failing to clear the UPSC exam despite five years of preparation in Prayagraj. Identified as Dr. Vipra Sharma, she reportedly turned to fraud to gain the status and authority she had long aspired to. She began presenting herself as a government officer, even installing a blue beacon on a black car and marking it with “Uttar Pradesh Government” and “SDM”. To maintain the illusion, she frequently switched vehicles and projected influence. Using this fake identity, she allegedly cheated multiple people by promising them government jobs. Investigators say she also roped in her real sister and a cousin, who assisted her in carrying out the scam. Read the complete story of the women fraudsters Seeing the status of friends, Vipra chose the path of fraud During police interrogation, it came to light that Dr. Vipra Sharma (35), who lives in Greater Green Park, has many people preparing for UPSC who are posted in high positions. Vipra felt jealous seeing their lifestyle and power. That's why she started claiming herself to be an IAS officer. ASP/CO City Pankaj Srivastava says - The investigation revealed that this gang has made dozens of people victims of fraud. So far, 4 victims have filed an FIR at Baradari police station. They were defrauded of approximately 11 lakh rupees. However, it is suspected that the fraud amount runs into crores. Because 55 lakh rupees were found in Vipra's bank account alone, which has been frozen. Many other people in the city may also be trapped in their net, who are not coming forward due to fear of public shame. Chose the path of crime even after higher education The profile of all three sisters can surprise anyone. The main accused Vipra Sharma is a PhD degree holder. She has completed MA in English and History. Her real sister Shikha Sharma (40) is also an MA pass. She was equally involved in the entire conspiracy. Meanwhile, cousin sister Diksha Pathak (32) is a BSc. She used to weave traps to ensnare victims. Then she would bring people to Vipra. Qualified PCS Pre in 2016, divorced in 2020 According to police, Vipra Sharma had qualified the PCS prelims in 2016. After that she got married, but got divorced in 2020. Following this, she started the act of posing as a fake ADM. She would regularly drive around with a blue beacon light and Uttar Pradesh Government plate on her vehicle. Created a crime syndicate, everyone had assigned roles Police investigation revealed that the girls had created such a 'crime syndicate' in which everyone had assigned roles. Diksha would find victims, Shikha would create the atmosphere and Vipra would pose as a fake officer to make the 'final deal'. The Mahindra XUV 700 and iPhone recovered from them are testimony to their luxury lifestyle, which they had built by looting others' hard-earned money. The secret was revealed on Preeti Layal's complaint This entire game of fraud started in the year 2022. Preeti Layal, a resident of Faik Enclave, told the police that she had met Diksha Pathak. Diksha had assured her that her sister Dr. Vipra Sharma was a high-ranking officer. She was posted as ADM. Diksha had claimed that her sister had high connections. She could get anyone a government job in exchange for money. Falling for this trap, along with Preeti, her acquaintances Adil Khan, Santosh Kumar and Mushahid Ali also got caught in this web hoping for jobs. Extorted lakhs of rupees through cash and bank accounts The three sisters gained the victims' trust by inviting them to their home. When these people reached Vipra Sharma and Shikha's house, their father Virendra Kumar Sharma was also present there. Vipra Sharma, claiming to be an IAS officer, said that recruitment for computer operator positions had been announced. She would get them appointed by giving money to senior officials. After this, the exchange of money began. Preeti deposited two lakh rupees in the bank account. Adil Khan gave one lakh eighty thousand rupees. Mushahid Ali went to Vipra Sharma's house and handed over a large amount of five lakh twenty-one thousand rupees in cash. Meanwhile, Santosh Kumar also paid two lakh rupees. The matter came to light when they reached Lucknow with fake appointment letters The accused also handed over fake appointment letters to the victims. Vipra Sharma prepared fake documents in the name of Revenue Council Lucknow. Fake signatures of then senior officials were also forged on them. These appointment letters were sent to the victims through post, WhatsApp and email. When these people reached Lucknow for joining, the officials there informed them that all these appointment letters were completely fake. After this revelation, the ground slipped from under the victims' feet. They realized that they had become victims of a large gang. When the victims demanded their money back, the accused threatened them. They flatly refused to return the money. After this, the victims gathered courage and narrated their ordeal to Baradari police. Now know the complete case

stories.title: 6 die in Unnao accident, women bodies torn apart:Severed head found far from spot, family travelling for child’s mundan ritual
stories.summary: Five women and a driver were killed in a road accident in Unnao on Wednesday. The dead include two sisters-in-law, their two daughters, and a neighbouring woman. In the crash, one woman’s head was severed, while two others were dismembered. Locals rushed to the spot after hearing screams and found a pile of bodies lying nearly six feet below the roadside. Blood-soaked body parts were scattered around. Five people, including two children, were seriously injured. See visuals of the horrific accident The accident occurred when a speeding Bolero tried to overtake and crashed into a truck ahead. At the same time, another truck coming from behind rammed into it. Trapped between the two trucks, the Bolero was crushed and pushed off the road, overturning nearly six feet below along with the trailing truck. There were 11 people in the Bolero, travelling to the Chandidevi temple for a child’s mundan ceremony. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath expressed grief and announced Rs 2 lakh compensation for each victim’s family. The accident took place around 10:30 am on the Unnao-Rae Bareli road, about 50 km from the district headquarters. Here is the full sequence of events in detail: Suraj Singh, a resident of Maurawan village in the Pathai police station area, had planned the mundan ceremony of his three-year-old son Shubh on Wednesday. Around 10 family members left in a Bolero vehicle in the morning to visit the Chandidevi temple in Baksar village for the ritual. Near Kiratpur village in the Bihar police station area, the Bolero collided with a truck ahead while attempting to overtake. Due to the sudden impact, the vehicle slowed down, and another truck coming from behind rammed into it. The Bolero lost control, fell nearly six feet off the roadside, and overturned. Following the collision, the truck driver behind also lost control of the steering, and his truck too veered off the road into a ditch. The truck ran over the Bolero before overturning further ahead. As a result, the Bolero was completely crushed. The passengers inside were severely trapped and injured. Three women were stuck inside and their bodies were torn into pieces. One woman’s head was severed and thrown about four feet away from the body. After the accident, villagers and passersby informed the police, who rushed to the spot. With the help of locals, the injured were pulled out and taken to the district hospital. During treatment, Bolero driver Ramdhani and two women died. Meanwhile, the truck driver and helper fled the scene after the accident. Among the injured are Suraj Singh (28), his daughter Bharti, his son Shubh Singh (around two-and-a-half years old), Gauri (7), daughter of Durgesh Singh, and Baua (8), son of Kallu. The family was on their way to perform Shubh’s mundan ceremony when the tragedy struck.

stories.title: Massive fire engulfs 7 floors of 15-storey Ghaziabad building:Residents flee to save their lives; women cry at scene; smoke visible from 5 km away
stories.summary: A massive fire broke out at Gaur Green Avenue Society in Ghaziabad at around 8:30 am on Wednesday. The fire started on the 9th floor of a 15-storey building and quickly spread to 7 upper floors, with thick smoke visible from some 5 km away. Residents escaped in time through the stairs. Some people faced breathing difficulties due to the smoke and were taken to hospital. 14 Fire tenders were deployed to subdue the flames, but due to the height of the affected floors, they were facing difficulties. People in the adjacent building have also joined in the efforts to control the fire. Hydraulic crane used to douse fire The fire in the upper floors of the building was brought under control with the help of a hydraulic crane. People from the adjacent building also joined efforts to extinguish the fire using hoses. The blaze was controlled after nearly three hours. The cause of the fire is still unknown. Ambulance and police teams are present at the spot. The building and nearby structures have been evacuated, and residents have been shifted to safer locations. The incident took place in the Abhay Khand area of Indirapuram. Pictures of the incident

stories.title: PM Modi inaugurates Ganga Expressway:Addresses public gathering in Hardoi, slams opposition for blocking Women’s Reservation Bill
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated Uttar Pradesh’s longest Ganga Expressway from Hardoi. He planted a sapling along the expressway and also walked on it with Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. The expressway passes through 12 districts and includes public convenience centres with stay facilities, trauma centres and food courts. Rumble strips have also been installed to reduce accidents by alerting drivers through vibration. A 3.5-km-long airstrip has been built near Jalalabad in Shahjahanpur for Indian Air Force fighter jet landings, which is also the country’s first night-landing airstrip. Petrol pumps have been set up every 75 km, operated by Bharat Petroleum. Before this, the 340-km Purvanchal Expressway was the longest in Uttar Pradesh. The Ganga Expressway is now the state’s sixth expressway. Visited the Kashi Vishwanath temple Earlier in the day, PM Modi visited the Kashi Vishwanath Temple in Varanasi on Wednesday and offered prayers. The roadshow commenced from Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW) and is scheduled to pass through Lahartara, Kachahri, Ambedkar Chauraha, Chaukaghat, Teliyabag, Lahurabir and Maidagin before culminating at the Kashi Vishwanath Dham, where the prime minister offered prayers. PM convoy received a grand welcome from party workers and locals before reaching the Kashi Vishwanath Temple. At the temple entrance, 108 young priests (Batuks) welcomed him with ceremonial conch blowing.

stories.title: Weather shifts in UP, heavy rain storm hits Mathura:6 districts, including Noida receive showers; alert in 58 cities
stories.summary: The weather has changed in UP. Heavy rain started in Bareilly at 8:55 AM on Wednesday. Before this, Noida experienced rain with a storm. Drizzle is occurring intermittently in Mathura, Saharanpur, Meerut, and Sambhal. Clouds are overcast in many districts of West UP. Cool winds are blowing. East UP is experiencing strong sunshine. However, people have got some relief from the heat. The Meteorological Department says that the weather has changed due to moist winds coming from the Bay of Bengal. Today, there is an alert for rain with thunderstorms in about 58 districts of Purvanchal, Awadh, Bundelkhand, and Braj regions. Lightning may also strike in some places. Earlier, on Tuesday, the mercury in 15 districts remained above 40 °C. Banda's temperature dropped by 2 degrees. Despite this, Banda city remained the hottest city in UP with 45.6 °C. On April 27, the mercury in Banda was recorded at 47.4 °C. Banda was the hottest in the state for the sixth time in April. Lucknow's meteorologist, Atul Singh, said, A new western disturbance has become active in the state. Due to this, a spell of rain with thunder and lightning has started. For the next 5 days, i.e., till May 4, rain will continue with strong winds. Relief will be felt from heat and heatwave. The temperature will drop by 3-4C. However, due to sunlight during the day, humid conditions may develop. 5 pictures of the weather- How will the weather be for the next 5 days?

stories.title: Will Brij Bhushan Singh return to SP again?:Seeks share on Ayodhya, Devipatan division seats, matter stuck on constituencies for sons
stories.summary: Political circles in Uttar Pradesh are abuzz with speculation that senior BJP leader Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh may switch to the Samajwadi Party (SP). Sources indicate that his talks with Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav are in the final stages, and if all goes well, Singh could appear on the SP platform by September–October. Singh’s occasional praise for Akhilesh Yadav and his visible discontent with the BJP leadership have further strengthened these claims. Now the question is, why does Brijbhushan want to change sides? What are his conditions for joining SP? In which districts does Brijbhushan have influence? How many tickets does he want to interfere with? Most importantly, what does Akhilesh Yadav want? Read this report, which seeks answers to all these questions… Why speculation around a switch is growing “Tell me if I’ve become a burden; I’ll prove my worth in 2027,” Singh recently remarked—seen as an open warning to the BJP. He has been upset since he was denied a ticket in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, where the BJP fielded his younger son, Karan Bhushan Singh, from the Kaiserganj seat instead. In a podcast in December 2025, Singh said, “I wasn’t removed by the people, but by a conspiracy. I will return one day.” He also acknowledged Akhilesh Yadav’s support during the controversy involving allegations by women wrestlers, saying he would not forget the gesture. First, understand why this claim is gaining strength What Brij Bhushan says Speaking to Dainik Bhaskar, Singh clarified, “I am currently in the BJP. I have received offers from Congress as well, but I declined. I have had good relations with Mulayam Singh and also share a good rapport with Akhilesh Yadav. Any future decision will be taken in consultation with my supporters.” SP spokesperson Udayveer Singh added, “As of now, he is in the BJP. Speculation often arises to enhance one’s stature within a party. The leadership will decide at the appropriate time.” Expert view: Potential boost for Samajwadi Party Senior journalist Suresh Bahadur Singh believes Brij Bhushan’s entry into SP could strengthen the party in eastern Uttar Pradesh. “Both Brij Bhushan and Mulayam Singh were wrestlers and shared a deep bond. Akhilesh also respects him. He has strong influence in districts like Gonda, Bahraich, and Balrampur, especially among Rajput voters. His entry could give SP an added advantage in the region,” he said. Not a new association with Samajwadi Party Brij Bhushan Singh is no stranger to the Samajwadi Party. He had joined SP in 2008 after being expelled from the BJP and won the 2009 Lok Sabha election on an SP ticket. He remained associated with the party until 2012. He has maintained cordial ties with the SP leadership over the years and has publicly praised Akhilesh Yadav, even describing him as a “religious person” in a past statement.

stories.title: New faces outshine ministers, MLAs in UP:Rajnath Singh’s son and Anurag Thakur’s former aide among preferred candidates
stories.summary: A large-scale survey conducted by Dainik Bhaskar across 403 assembly constituencies in Uttar Pradesh has revealed surprising voter preferences, with people in 130 seats favouring new and lesser-known faces over sitting MLAs and even senior ministers. The findings point to changing political expectations ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. Ministers and Established leaders rejected in several constituencies The survey indicates that in multiple constituencies, respondents preferred fresh candidates over established political leaders, including serving ministers. Among notable names is AK Sharma, a former Gujarat bureaucrat and current Uttar Pradesh Energy Minister, who has not yet contested a direct assembly election but emerged as a preferred candidate in several areas. He is currently an MLC. In Ballia Nagar, voters reportedly preferred former MLA Anand Swaroop Shukla over sitting Transport Minister Dayashankar Singh. Rajnath Singh’s son among preferred faces in Lucknow East In Lucknow East constituency, voters rejected sitting MLA OP Srivastava and instead showed preference for Neeraj Singh, younger son of Defence Minister Rajnath Singh. His elder brother Pankaj Singh is already an MLA from Noida. Neeraj Singh has earlier served as campaign in-charge during his father’s Lok Sabha election campaigns and currently holds positions such as Chairman of the Uttar Pradesh Yoga Association and President of the UP Boxing Federation. New entrants and Outsiders gain ground in several seats In Akbarpur (Ambedkar Nagar), voters rejected sitting Samajwadi Party MLA Ramachal Rajbhar and preferred Vivek Maurya as their candidate. Maurya, a former journalist and former personal assistant to former Union Minister Anurag Thakur, has been active politically in the region for several years. In Malhani constituency of Jaunpur, voters did not prefer sitting Samajwadi Party MLA Lucky Yadav. Interestingly, controversial strongman Dhananjay Singh emerged as the preferred BJP candidate, although his eligibility to contest remains uncertain due to a criminal conviction case. Former BJP candidate KP Singh ranked third in preference. Five emerging faces who surpassed senior leaders The survey also highlighted several lesser-known political figures who gained strong voter support over established leaders: Clear signal of changing political preferences The survey highlights a strong shift in voter sentiment, with growing demand for new leadership and local emerging faces over established politicians. The results indicate potential changes in candidate selection strategies by major parties ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections.

stories.title: Soldier found dead, wife detained in Kanpur Dehat:Body discovered in locked room after foul smell; ₹30 lakh fund withdrawn
stories.summary: On Tuesday, the nude body of an army jawan was found covered in blood in Kanpur Dehat. Family members have accused the wife of murder. Police have taken the wife into custody and are interrogating her. The jawan was posted in Ahmednagar, Maharashtra. He had come home on leave about 15 days ago. He had withdrawn Rs 30 lakh from his GPF. He had also sold a plot of land. First, see 2 pictures Now read the full story Anand alias Suvendra Singh Chauhan (33), residing in Subhash Nagar, was serving in the army. Suvendra was originally from Murli Purwa (Lachhiya) Kanchaunsi, Auraiya. Currently, he was living with his wife and two sons in a rented house in Subhash Nagar, Jhinjhak. Suvendra had come home on leave on April 13. Brother Rajendra Pratap said - 2 months ago, Suvendra had withdrawn Rs 30 lakh from his fund. He had also sold a plot. Driven by the greed for this money, his brother was murdered on the night of 26-27. On Tuesday, his wife Nidhi called, saying that Suvendra had not come out of his room for the past two days. Perhaps something untoward had happened. Upon this, we reached the spot. We broke open the door and went inside, where brother Suvendra was found dead. Rajendra alleges that his brother was killed by his wife Nidhi and brother-in-law together. Except for Nidhi, all the in-laws have absconded. The body was found naked, and there was blood scattered nearby. This suggests that he was attacked with a sharp weapon. Suvendra's aunt, Pushpa, stated that the husband and wife often used to fight. On Tuesday, his wife Nidhi informed her sister-in-law that Suvendra had not opened the room door for the past two days. A foul smell was also coming from inside. Upon receiving the information, the police reached the spot and sent the body for post-mortem. A medicine bottle and a liquor bottle were also found at the scene. The police said that the matter is being investigated. The exact cause of death will only be known after the post-mortem report comes out.

stories.title: Bride going to beauty parlor crushed by trailer:Wheel ran over head; wedding was to take place today
stories.summary: A 20-year-old bride-to-be was killed in a tragic road accident on her wedding day in Deoria district on Tuesday, turning a day of celebration into mourning. Rachna Paswan, a resident of Gaur Kothi village, was on her way to a beauty parlour when the incident occurred. She was travelling on a motorbike with her cousin sister Pooja (18) and cousin brother Mukesh. Around 2 pm, near Bariyarpur intersection—about 10 km from her home—a sand-laden trailer rammed into their bike from behind. Now know the complete matter... The impact threw all three onto the road. Rachna fell under the trailer and was run over, dying on the spot. Pooja and Mukesh sustained minor injuries and were rushed to hospital by police. Rachna was the only sister among two brothers. Her father, who works in Mumbai, had arranged her marriage two years ago with a man from Kushinagar. The wedding procession was due to arrive on April 28, and preparations were underway at home when the accident occurred. According to family members, the bike rider had applied sudden brakes near the intersection, following which the speeding trailer hit them with force. After the collision, the driver fled the scene, abandoning the vehicle. Police reached the spot, sent the body for postmortem and seized the trailer. A search is underway to trace the absconding driver. The incident has left the family devastated, with wedding celebrations turning into grief overnight.

stories.title: Fake IAS gang of 3 sisters arrested in Bareilly:Duped job seekers of ₹11 lakh using fake posts, forged letters, and false promises of govt jobs
stories.summary: Police have caught 3 sisters who were committing fraud by posing as fake IAS officers in Bareilly. Among them, two are real sisters, and one is their maternal uncle's daughter. All three sisters were defrauding people in the name of providing government jobs. One sister has completed her PHD and has also qualified for PCS Prelims. Meanwhile, the other two sisters have done an MA and a BSc. All three are married. The case is from the Baradari police station area. Now know the complete case Complaint was filed on April 26 Preeti Layal, a resident of Fike Enclave, filed a complaint at the Baradari police station on April 26. She said, “I met a woman who introduced herself as Shikha Pathak. She told me that her sister, Dr. Vipra Sharma, is an ADM (FR) and arranges government jobs in exchange for money. She claimed she could get a computer operator job through UPSSSC.” “After this, I informed my acquaintances Adil Khan, Santosh Kumar, and Mushahid. All four of us needed jobs, so we went to meet Shikha Pathak and Vipra Sharma at their house. Their father, Virendra Kumar Sharma, was also present there. On the pretext of arranging jobs, they collectively took around ₹11 lakh from the four of us through cash and bank transfers.” Two real sisters and one cousin were committing fraud Shikha Sharma (40) and Vipra Sharma (35), residents of the Baradari police station area, are real sisters. Diksha Pathak (32) is their maternal uncle's daughter. All three are married. Shikha Sharma has even been divorced. Vipra and Diksha live with their husbands. Vipra Sharma has completed a double MA, PhD, and has qualified for PCS Pre. Meanwhile, Shikha Sharma has done an MA, and Diksha Pathak has studied up to BSc. Both of them had been committing fraud along with Vipra Sharma since the year 2022. The three sisters had divided their work among themselves. Diksha would find victims, and Shikha would create the atmosphere. Meanwhile, Vipra would pose as a fake officer and make the 'final deal'. The accused sisters say that they liked using blue lights and expensive hobbies. That's why they were fulfilling their hobbies by committing fraud. After being caught, the three sisters say that they are educated. They haven't had any job till now. They have a hobby of traveling in cars with blue lights and buying expensive things. That's why they were living by posing as fake officers. With the money from the fraud, they had bought a house. Sitting there, they would make fake joining letters. Apart from this, they also bought a white colored Mahindra XUV700 car. Complaint was registered on 26 April Preeti Layal, a resident of Faik Enclave, lodged a complaint at the Baradari police station on 26 April. She stated that I met a woman. She told me her name was Shikha Pathak. Shikha Pathak told me that her sister, Dr. Vipra Sharma, is ADM FR. She takes money and gets government jobs. She claimed to get a computer operator job through UPSSSC. I informed my acquaintances Adil Khan, Santosh Kumar, and Mushahid about this. All four needed jobs. So we went to meet Shikha Pathak and Vipra Sharma at their house. Their father, Virendra Kumar Sharma, was also present there. In the name of getting jobs, they took approximately ₹11 lakh in cash and through the bank from all four people. Fraud exposed upon reaching Lucknow After this, Vipra Sharma prepared fake joining letters in the name of the Commissioner and Secretary, Revenue Council UP, Lucknow. She sent them through email, post, and WhatsApp. These letters were prepared in the name of the Revenue Council, Lucknow. These also had forged signatures of alleged officials. When the victims reached Lucknow to join, the officials there made it clear that all these letters were fake. After this, the victims realized they had been cheated. When the victims demanded their money back, the three sisters threatened them. After this, the victims filed a complaint at the Baradari police station. The police have registered a case under sections of fraud and creating fake documents and arrested the accused. Currently, the police are also investigating how many more people this gang has made victims of fraud.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Modi arrives in Kashi to inaugurate Signature Bridge; UP’s Banda becomes the world’s hottest place at 47.6°C more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Modi arrives in Kashi to inaugurate Signature Bridge Prime Minister Narendra Modi has reached Kashi for the women’s public protest rally. He arrived in an open jeep and waved to the crowd while making his way to the stage. UP Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, BJP president Nitin Naveen and state president Pankaj Chaudhary were also present with him in the jeep. 2. UP’s Banda becomes the world’s hottest place at 47.6°C Severe heatwave conditions swept across large parts of India on Monday. Banda in Uttar Pradesh emerged as the hottest city in the world, recording a scorching 47.6°C, surpassing its previous records. 3. Yogi announces 1 lakh new police jobs: Openings for home guards CM Yogi announced on Tuesday in Lucknow that 1 lakh new recruitments will be made in UP Police this year. He said - recruitment will be done for Home Guard, Police, and Sub-Inspector posts. The CM distributed joining letters to 936 radio operators. He also took photos with them. 4. Israel destroys over 1,000 sites in Lebanon despite ceasefire extension The Israeli military on Tuesday said it has destroyed more than 1,000 sites used by Hezbollah in southern Lebanon, including booby-trapped structures and buildings allegedly used to store weapons. 5. Mahua Moitra shares UP’s IPS Ajay Pal’s video, claims he danced with dancer Uttar Pradesh encounter specialist IPS Ajay Pal Sharma has been appointed as an observer in West Bengal by the Election Commission. Soon after taking charge, he came into action. 6. Hardoi school principal apologises for misbehaving with student’s parent In Hardoi, the principal who misbehaved with a child's parent finally had to apologise publicly. The matter escalated when workers of the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad reached the school premises for a protest. 7. Campaigning ends for Phase 2 of WB polls Campaigning for the second phase of the West Bengal Assembly elections concluded on Monday evening, setting the stage for polling across 142 seats on April 29. 8. Ganga Expressway passing through 12 districts to open tomorrow The Ganga Expressway in UP is ready. PM Modi will inaugurate it on April 29. This 594-kilometre expressway will connect Meerut to Prayagraj. It will change the face of the 12 districts it passes through. 9. BJP plans to deploy women ministers; Akhilesh to promote Ragini Sonkar and Naseem Solanki After the Women's Reservation Amendment Bill failed in the Lok Sabha, the UP government is convening a special session of the legislature on April 30. There is a plan to bring a censure motion against the opposition in it. 10. Pakistan's missile strike on Afghanistan kills 7, injures 75 At least seven people were killed and more than 75 were injured in a series of attacks in eastern Afghanistan’s Kunar Province on Monday, amid rising tensions between Afghanistan and Pakistan.

stories.title: Akhilesh reaches to meet injured BJP MLA:Leader smiles on seeing Samajwadi Party chief; suffered burns during effigy burning
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief and Lok Sabha MP Akhilesh Yadav suddenly reached Medanta Hospital on Tuesday. He inquired about the well-being of BJP MLA Anupama Jaiswal, who is admitted there. When Akhilesh greeted her with folded hands, Anupama smiled. Akhilesh also spoke to the doctors treating the MLA. Akhilesh shared a photo of the meeting on social media. On which a couplet was written, 'Let the politicians know their duty, my message is love, wherever it reaches.' Anupama, MLA from Bahraich, was immolating effigies of Akhilesh Yadav and Rahul Gandhi on April 25 in protest against the 'Nari Vandan Adhiniyam' (Women's Reservation Bill) failing in Parliament, when she got burnt. Immediately after this incident, Akhilesh posted a video on X. He wrote, 'Those who set fires beware. Arrangements should be made for the treatment of the woman who set the fire.' See 2 photos Akhilesh said- Politics has its place, the importance of human relations has its own place SP chief said, we do not want fire to ignite among society. We want a shower of harmony in society. The healthy tradition of our positive politics has taught us this. That is why we went to meet BJP MLA Anupama Jaiswal. We have wished for her speedy recovery. Politics has its place and the importance of human relations has its place. May goodwill prevail, may harmony prevail! SP Media Cell said - PM and CM should have visited In this matter, SP Media Cell targeted PM Modi and CM Yogi. Wrote on X, even if political parties are different, ideologies are different, but SP chief Akhilesh Yadav is at the forefront of respecting women and promoting harmony. BJP MLA Anupama Jaiswal had accidentally burned herself while setting fire to an effigy of SP chief Akhilesh Yadav. To see her, inquire about her well-being, and wish her good health, the SP chief himself reached Medanta Hospital. He met Anupama, inquired about her well-being, wished her good health, and met her family members. Whereas Prime Minister Modi and Chief Minister Adityanath Bisht should have gone themselves to meet their MLA, but they were busy with the Bengal elections and were criticizing the opposition. The difference between BJP and Samajwadi Party regarding women's safety and 'Nari Vandan' (respect for women) is clear. How the incident happened, read in sequence In Bahraich, on April 25, at 1 PM, BJP workers were protesting regarding the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam (Women's Power Salutation Act). As soon as the workers set fire to the effigy, the flames flared up and came onto MLA Anupama Jaiswal's face. Her face and hair were scorched. Workers and policemen present at the spot immediately extinguished the fire with a cloth. The MLA was immediately admitted to the district hospital for treatment. From there, she was sent to Medanta. Anupama Jaiswal was the Minister of Basic Education and Women and Child Development for about 2 years during the first term of the Yogi government. See 3 pictures of the incident After her face was scorched, the MLA fled from the spot. Workers and policemen rescued her. Senior journalist said - Akhilesh set a new example Senior journalist Ashok Tripathi, who has covered SP for a long time, says, Akhilesh Yadav has set a new example of political conduct. At the same time, he has tried to send a message to his opponents that his fight is ideological, not personal. Akhilesh Yadav has hit several targets with one arrow. He neither complained nor made any adverse comment when his own effigy was burnt. Anupama is a woman MLA, and he has tried to send a message to women. Akhilesh Yadav fields his close aide Yasir Shah from the Bahraich Sadar seat, from which Anupama Jaiswal is an MLA. In 2022, Anupama Jaiswal won the election by about 4,000 votes. This is a move that even the BJP will not be able to attack, even if it wants to. Because no big BJP leader came to visit Anupama Jaiswal, who has been admitted to the hospital for four days. Now, know about the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam On April 17, 2026, during a special session of Parliament, the 131st Constitution Amendment Bill related to women's reservation failed in the Lok Sabha. This bill was rejected for the 7th time in 30 years, as the government failed to gather the necessary two-thirds majority to pass it. This time, 298 votes were cast in its favor, while 230 votes were against it. This bill was related to providing 33% reservation for women, along with delimitation. Opposition parties had demanded immediate implementation of the reservation without census and delimitation, while the government presented it by linking it with these. This was the first time in 12 years of governance that the Modi government could not pass a bill in the House. Earlier, Amit Shah had said in an hour-long speech in the Lok Sabha that if these bills are not passed, the opposition would be responsible. After the bill failed, the BJP made it an issue. Protests were held against the opposition in various places.

stories.title: Wife attacks husband with acid in Pilibhit:Victim says he mistook it for hot tea; dispute for 5 years
stories.summary: In Pilibhit on Sunday, a wife threw acid on her husband. The husband was severely burnt by this. Splashes of acid also fell on the wife, injuring her as well. CCTV footage of the incident has also surfaced. The video shows the woman standing at the gate on the second floor. As soon as the husband comes near the gate from the adjacent room, she pours the glass full of acid on him. The husband said - I initially thought she had thrown hot tea. I went to the kitchen and washed my face. Even after this, the burning sensation kept increasing. Then I went to the bathroom and took a shower. After this, the acid went into my mouth. When I tasted something sour, I understood that acid had been thrown. Actually, there has been a dispute between the husband and wife for 5 years. The wife has also filed a case of dowry harassment against the husband. Meanwhile, the husband has accused the wife of having an affair. The matter is from the City Kotwali area. First, see 2 pictures Now the complete matter in detail Hemant (35) lives with his daughter Arya (4) in Khairullah Shah Mohalla. He is a goldsmith by profession. Hemant was married to Shilpi (32), a resident of Lakhimpur, 6 years ago in 2020. Hemant alleges that a year after their marriage, he found out that Shilpi was having an affair with a young man. Hemant also complained about this to his in-laws. After this, he had a quarrel with Shilpi. In 2021, Shilpi filed a case of dowry harassment against Hemant. After this, she packed her belongings and went to her parental home. Hemant said - When I was not at home, Shilpi's lover Vimal used to come to the house. I have also caught both of them red-handed. I also have proof of this. Shilpi repeatedly tried to enter the house Hemant said - Troubled by my wife, I filed for divorce. When Shilpi received the divorce notice in February 2026, the dispute between us escalated. Even after filing the divorce case, Shilpi repeatedly tried to enter my house. During this time, the police also made me sit at the police station for several hours many times. They also issued a challan for disturbing the peace. Wife went to the second floor and threw acid Shilpi reached Pilibhit from her maternal home Lakhimpur around 4 PM on Sunday evening. She started creating a ruckus outside Hemant's house. Hemant called 112. Police also arrived at the scene, but the police returned as there was no female police officer with them. After this, Shilpi forcibly entered Hemant's house. Hemant was on the second floor of the house. There is a meshed gate on the second floor. Hemant's room is adjacent to that gate. As soon as Hemant came out of the room, Shilpi threw acid on him with a glass from outside the mesh. Some acid splashes also fell on Shilpi, due to which she also got burnt. Both Hemant and Shilpi were admitted to the district hospital, where Hemant's condition remains serious. City Kotwal Satyendra Kumar said that an impartial investigation into the matter would be conducted.

stories.title: Uma Bharti says reservation cannot be scrapped:'It will continue untill President's PM families study in govt schools'
stories.summary: Former CM Uma Bharti made a big statement regarding reservation at the valor journey of Raja Hirdeshah Lodhi, organized at Jamburi Maidan in the capital Bhopal. She said reservation is necessary for social equality in the country. Uma Bharti said- Until the families of the President, Prime Minister, and Chief Justice study together in government schools, no one can snatch away reservation. She said that Indian society remained divided on caste lines for a long time, and economic inequalities were deep. In such a situation, reservation is a major effort to reduce that disparity. Equality will come not just through law, but through changes in behavior. When the families of people holding top positions in the country also study in government schools, then real equality will come in both the education system and society. During this, Uma Bharti was welcomed by being presented with a shield and a sword. In the program, Panchayat Minister Prahlad Patel, Tourism Minister Dharmendra Singh Lodhi, Balaghat MLA Anubha Munjare, Pichhore MLA Pritam Lodhi, Banda MLA Virendra Singh Lambardar, Bada Malhara MLA Ram Siya Bharti, Bargi MLA Neeraj Singh Thakur, State President of Lodhi Lodha Mahasabha Jalam Singh Patel, and Kaushalendra Singh, descendant of King Hirdeshah, along with a large number of people from the Lodhi-Lodha community were present. Uma said - Now I will tell you about the second battle for independence. When Modi ji took oath as Prime Minister in 2014, an editor of an American newspaper wrote, 'The British left, but they left behind some 'black British'." We are modernizing, but not Westernizing. When BJP was formed after Jan Sangh, it was called a backward and opposition party. For the first time, one person gave up his chair for the Ram Temple. Another gave up his chair for the tricolor. After this, a community broke the illusion that BJP is an anti-backward party. India will take back PoK Uma Bharti said that power was relinquished in Uttar Pradesh for the Ram Janmabhoomi movement, while in Madhya Pradesh, the post was resigned for the respect of the tricolor. She said that this new freedom is progressing under the leadership of Narendra Modi. India will one day reclaim Pakistan Occupied Kashmir. Pakistan will have to kneel and apologize. She also said that by responding to the Pahalgam incident, India has proven its strength. The third battle for freedom should be for equality Uma Bharti said that in Indian culture, trees, mountains, and even living beings are worshipped, and there is no discrimination of any kind in it. The country has struggled for a long time for independence, but now the third battle for freedom should be fought for the right to equality. Uma said The Lodhi community has a significant population, and governments are formed with their participation. This community has the power to form governments. Pritam said At least one Lodhi CM should be made in India Pichhore MLA Pritam Lodhi said If Hema Malini's Dharmendra can get Bharat Ratna, then why can't our Kalyan Singh get it? Pritam said The world follows where youth leads. When I go out to see the youth, today's youth is found in playing cards. It is found in liquor shops. When we were young, we had two chief ministers from our community. Today there are zero. There should be at least one Lodhi chief minister in India.

stories.title: Mahua Moitra calls IPS Ajay Pal ‘Fair and Lovely babua’:Taunts him, 'Hope your policing skills are better than your dancing skills'
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh encounter specialist IPS Ajay Pal Sharma has been appointed as an observer in West Bengal by the Election Commission. Soon after taking charge, he has come into action. On Monday, he issued a strict warning to Trinamool Congress (TMC) candidate Jahangir Khan. He said that if voters are threatened or intimidated, strict action will be taken and it will be dealt with firmly. He also warned that there should be no later complaints or regrets. A video of IPS Ajay Pal Sharma has also surfaced. He had received complaints that TMC leader Jahangir Khan was allegedly trying to scare voters. Following this, he himself reached the spot. Under his leadership, teams of SSB, FST and QRT carried out raids in the area. Jahangir Khan is considered close to West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee’s nephew Abhishek Banerjee. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has called IPS Ajay Pal Sharma an agent of the BJP. He said that at the right time, a deep investigation will be conducted into the alleged wrongdoings of such people working as agents, and strict punishment will follow. On the other hand, the TMC has referred to Ajay Pal Sharma as the “notorious Singham”. The party said that this is West Bengal, not Uttar Pradesh. Know the full story See 2 photos Mahua Moitra attacked Ajay Pal in three posts, TMC MP Mahua Moitra has made three posts against Ajay Pal on X. She made her first post on Monday night at 9:57 PM. In it, she posted a video of Ajay Pal's warning and wrote - My Fair Lovely babua Ajay Pal Sharma (@DripsAjaypal). We are the kind of people who properly deal with your Chhota Fanta and Bada Fanta too. Be a little careful with your heroics. Mahua made the second post on Tuesday morning at 9:30 AM. She wrote- Good to see you enjoying yourself in 'Fanta Cop' style. Stay 'Thanda Thanda, Cool Cool'. Bengal is always Trinamool's. Along with this, two videos were also posted. In the first video, the person who looks like Ajay Pal Sharma is standing in front of a woman and clapping, while the woman is sitting down and doing dance steps. In the second video, the person is seen standing very close to a woman and swaying to the song 'Choli Ke Peeche Kya Hai'. The third post she made at 10 AM. It read - Ajay Pal Sharma, hope your policing skills are better than your dancing skills just saying. Jahangir Khan's reply - The picture is not over yet Jahangir Khan has replied to Ajay Pal Sharma. He said - You started the game, but I will finish it. The picture is not over yet. The match has started. You think you are creating a spectacle with a few CRPF jawans. But if everyone comes together, you people will be blown away. Akhilesh said - Criminals of democracy will not be spared Voting to be held on 142 seats on April 29 Voting for 152 seats in the first phase of the West Bengal Assembly Elections 2026 has already taken place on April 23. During this period, barring minor incidents, the polling remained peaceful. The second phase of voting is scheduled for April 29. Votes will be cast on a total of 142 seats, including Kolkata. Considering the sensitivity of the second phase, the Election Commission has sent 11 new police observers to Bengal. One of them is IPS Ajay Pal Sharma. The results of the assembly elections will be announced on May 4. Now read about Ajay Pal Sharma and Mahua Moitra Ajay Pal Sharma- From Dental Surgeon to Encounter Specialist Ajay Pal Sharma, who became an IPS officer in 2011 after being a dentist, is also known as an 'Encounter Specialist'. In his 15-year career, he has carried out more than 500 encounters. In these, 15 criminals were killed, while others were arrested. Dr. Ajay Pal Sharma, a resident of Ludhiana, Punjab, was a dental surgeon before becoming an IPS officer. He obtained his BDS (Dental Sciences) degree from Government Medical College, Patiala. His younger brother, Amit Pal Sharma, is an IAS officer. The 41-year-old Ajay Pal is currently posted as Additional CP (Law and Order) in Prayagraj. Prior to this, he has served as SP/SSP in five districts. During his 22-month tenure as SP in Jaunpur, he carried out a record 136 encounters. This is the highest number of encounters in any district during an SP's tenure. Commanded these districts He has served as the Superintendent of Police (SP) for Hathras, Shamli, Rampur, and Jaunpur. In 2013, he was posted as ASP during the Kumbh Mela held in Prayagraj. He was also given responsibility as SP Personnel at Police Headquarters and as the head of UP-112. Woman had made serious allegations Ajay Pal Sharma's career has been full not only of successes but also of controversies. In 2020, a woman named Deepti Sharma made serious allegations against him. The woman claimed that Ajay Pal had married her in 2016 and later reneged. This case escalated so much that an FIR was registered against him at Hazratganj police station in Lucknow, and an SIT investigation was also launched. Due to this controversy, his promotion was also stalled for a long time, although he was later given a clean chit. Served as Nodal Officer in Mahakumbh Just before the Mahakumbh, he was appointed as Nodal Officer (Mahakumbh, Prayagraj Commissionerate) in Prayagraj. On December 22, 2024, he was made Additional CP Prayagraj. During this period, he played a significant role in the successful organisation of the Mahakumbh. After the Mahakumbh, he was entrusted with the responsibility of Additional CP (Law and Order), Prayagraj.

stories.title: Legislature’s special session ahead:BJP plans to deploy women ministers; Akhilesh to promote Ragini Sonkar and Naseem Solanki
stories.summary: After the Women's Reservation Amendment Bill failed in the Lok Sabha, the UP government is convening a special session of the legislature on April 30. There is a plan to bring a censure motion against the opposition in it. Through this, the BJP government will try to send a message that Congress and SP did not allow the bill to pass due to their anti-women policies. Meanwhile, the opposition will target the BJP over the timing of bringing the bill. In fact, when the central government brought the amendment bill in the Lok Sabha, election campaigns were underway in 5 states, including Tamil Nadu and West Bengal. The opposition alleged that the BJP government wanted to change the country's electoral map. This bill has been brought keeping in mind the electoral benefits of 2029. Overall, a huge uproar is certain in UP's special session. Before that, know what kind of atmosphere the BJP has created around the Women's Reservation Bill in UP? Protests began in UP from the very next day after the bill failed Immediately after the Women's Reservation Amendment Bill failed in the Lok Sabha on April 17, BJP's women MPs protested against the opposition in the Parliament complex. From the very next day, BJP launched a major campaign in UP to corner the SP and Congress on this issue. CM Yogi and Union Minister Annapurna Yadav held a press conference. A protest rally of women was taken out from the Chief Minister's residence. CM Yogi himself led the rally. During this, many senior leaders including BJP State President Pankaj Chaudhary, Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya, and Brajesh Pathak were present. Government to prioritize women MLAs and ministers BJP has a sufficient majority in both houses. Due to this, the passing of the resolution is considered certain. During the discussion on the censure motion, women MLAs and ministers will be put forward by the ruling party. During this, criminal incidents against women during the SP government will also be mentioned. Additionally, BJP is running a campaign across UP to create an atmosphere against the opposition. Women's wing workers are contacting women door-to-door. Protests and effigy burning programs are being organized in every district. Attempt to consolidate women's vote bank against the opposition Senior journalist Virendranath Bhatt believes that women played a big role in BJP winning the assembly and Lok Sabha elections in UP from 2017 to 2022. The Yogi government is running various schemes for women, including Mission Shakti. The perception has been formed that crimes against women have decreased under the Yogi government. Women can safely go out on the streets. BJP also needs the women's vote bank in the 2027 assembly elections. Through this session, the government is trying to woo the women's vote bank. The Yogi government and the BJP organization are trying to reach out to as many women as possible and tell them that their rights were snatched due to the opposition of SP-Congress. SP called a meeting to formulate strategy Meanwhile, the SP has called a meeting of its legislative party on April 29 to decide its strategy for the special session. Party president Akhilesh Yadav will also be present. Women MLAs from the SP will also lead from the house to the street. During this, cases like Hathras incident, Unnao rape case and gang rape of a student at IIT-BHU can be raised. Regarding the special session, SP MLA Ragini Sonkar says - This is a misuse of the public's hard-earned money. The women who came to the BJP rally themselves didn't know why they had come? They are bringing women onto the streets. Someone's clothes are burning, someone's face is burning. BJP is using women for its political self-interest. Congress said - This is BJP's political stunt Aradhana Mishra, leader of the Congress Legislature Party, says - the reality of BJP has been exposed before women. Women have come to know the truth. Congress's opposition is to conducting delimitation without census. If BJP wants to advance women, then why doesn't it make a woman national president? BJP has played this political stunt due to the West Bengal assembly elections. But, BJP will not get any benefit from it. If politics is played on this by the ruling party in the special session of the assembly, we will oppose it.

stories.title: PM Modi slams SP, Congress in Kashi:Says both parties betrayed women; vows to secure reservation for them
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed women in Bhojpuri. He said, “I bow to the mothers and sisters of Kashi.” He accused Congress, TMC and SP of betraying women once again, adding that these dynastic parties are afraid of women’s strength. He said he would leave no stone unturned to ensure reservation for women. The Prime Minister arrived in Kashi on Tuesday for a two-day visit. At the BLW (Banaras Locomotive Works) ground, he reached the venue in an open jeep among around 25,000 women. He waved and greeted the crowd as he made his way to the stage. At the conference, 44 women from fields such as politics, self-help groups and healthcare were seated on the stage. The Prime Minister laid the foundation stone and inaugurated 163 projects worth ₹6,350 crore. These include the Signature Bridge and a super-speciality hospital at Kabirchaura Divisional Hospital. The Prime Minister also flagged off two new trains. One will run between Varanasi and Pune, while the other will operate from Ayodhya to Mumbai. Meanwhile, on Tuesday, before the PM's arrival, Bengali women blew conch shells at Chausathi Ghat in Kashi. The women said that they are confident of victory in the ongoing elections in Bengal, and this event is being organised in Kashi in that joy. According to BJP sources, the Prime Minister will reach Varanasi by special plane after 4 PM. From the airport, he will land at Bareka helipad by army helicopter. From there, he will reach the rally venue, BLW Ground. Here, the PM will address 40,000 women regarding the non-passage of the Nari Shakti Vandan Amendment Act. The Prime Minister will also seek women's opinions on this act here.

stories.title: Gorakhpur accident during kite flying:Iron rod pierces child’s chest; mother rushes him to hospital with it
stories.summary: In Gorakhpur, a rebar on the roof pierced through the chest and neck of a 14-year-old boy. Actually, Harsh was flying a kite on the roof early in the morning. During this, his foot slipped and he fell onto a rebar protruding from an incomplete pillar on the roof. Harsh started screaming and shouting due to the pain. Hearing her son's scream, the mother reached the roof. She called out to family members. The family informed the police. A rebar cutter was called. He cut the rebar and separated it from the roof. The mother took the child, along with the rebar, to the district hospital. During this, the child kept groaning in pain. A team of doctors removed the rebar after an operation that lasted for about 2 hours. Doctors said - the family acted wisely. They did not try to remove the rebar. Because of this, there was no blood loss. The incident occurred on Monday morning at 9 AM in the Ilahibagh Lala Toli area, under the Tiwaripur police station. Now, understand the whole matter sequentially- Amresh Srivastava has a single-story house in the Lala Toli area of Ilaibagh. He works as a waiter. Some construction on the roof is left incomplete. Rebars are protruding from small pillars. Besides his wife Aditi Srivastava, the family has 3 children, including one girl. Harsh is their eldest son. One room in the house is rented out. Mother Aditi said- On Monday morning, her husband had gone out. Around 9 AM, Harsh was playing on the roof. She scolded him twice and brought him down. After that, she started cooking. Above the stairs leading to the roof, there is a tin shed canopy supported by an 8-foot wall, so that rainwater and sunlight do not fall on the stairs. She said that suddenly Harsh climbed onto the tin shed built over the stairs and started flying a kite. A little while later, she heard his screams. I ran from the kitchen to the roof. I saw Harsh stuck in the rebar of a pillar on the roof. He was writhing in pain. I didn't understand anything, so I called out to the tenant. The child was screaming- Akash Bhaiya, save me Aditi said- My son was saying, 'Akash bhaiya, save me.' Akash is the name of my tenant. Hearing the sound, Akash came upstairs. He said that removing the rebar could lead to death. He informed the police. He called my husband and told him everything. We called a craftsman working in a nearby house and had the rod cut. During this, my son was writhing in pain. He was crying loudly. I rushed Harsh to the district hospital. He was admitted. Where doctors removed the rod after the operation. Dr. V.K. Suman, CMS of the district hospital, said- The iron rod had entered the child's right side of the chest and exited from above the neck. The child's condition was very serious. The entire surgical team was called. An immediate operation was decided upon. The iron rod was removed from the child's body in an operation lasting about two hours. The child's condition is now improving.
