stories.title: Ganga Expressway passing through 12 districts to open tomorrow:Travel time will likely to drop from 11 to 6 hours
stories.summary: The Ganga Expressway in UP is ready. PM Modi will inaugurate it on April 29. This 594-kilometre expressway will connect Meerut to Prayagraj. It will change the face of the 12 districts it passes through. The expressway will reduce the 11-hour journey to 6 hours. Meerut to benefit most from Ganga Expressway Meerut is counted among the big industrial cities of UP. Sports goods, readymade garments, and leather products are manufactured here. Until now, its main market was Delhi, because the distance from Delhi to Meerut is about 80 km. With the construction of the Ganga Expressway, products from here will now reach Bulandshahr, Shahjahanpur, Lucknow, Prayagraj, and their surrounding districts. This will benefit both traders and buyers. Manufacturing, logistics, and warehousing will also increase here. This will create thousands of jobs. The expressway in Meerut is a total of 15 kilometers long. It starts from Bijoli village. With the construction of the expressway, land in the vicinity has become expensive. The land rate has increased from two and a half thousand rupees/square feet to 6 thousand rupees/square feet. Logistic cluster to be built in Hapur The Ganga Expressway will also give a new identity to the Hapur district, which was carved out of Ghaziabad in 2011. The district has home furnishing, steel, paper, laminated product, rice, and sugar mills. Through the expressway, doing business from here to Purvanchal will become easier. An Integrated Manufacturing and Logistics Cluster (IMLC) is also to be built here. This is a modern 'Industrial Township' model where all facilities for manufacturing, storing, and dispatching goods will be available in one place. Youth of Bulandshahr will benefit The government is going to develop an industrial corridor in Bulandshahr. For this, 120 hectares of land has been selected along the Ganga Expressway. This will provide employment to the youth who go to Delhi-Ghaziabad in search of jobs, right near their homes once the corridor is built. There is only one train from Bulandshahr to Prayagraj. This expressway will improve connectivity between the two cities. In the coming time, a link expressway will be built to connect the Ganga Expressway with Jewar Airport. 80% of this will be in Bulandshahr. Amroha's sugarcane will get a new identity Sugarcane cultivation is extensive in Amroha. With the express-way operational, transport time will decrease. This will provide traders with markets in new cities. Sugarcane will reach large markets like Delhi, Meerut, and Lucknow quickly. The government is planning to establish industrial corridors and MSME units along the express-way. This will benefit the youth. It will be easier to visit Kalki Vishnu Temple in Sambhal Sambhal is an ancient city of Hindu faith. It houses Lord Kalki Vishnu Temple, Manokamna Temple, Gauri Sahai Temple, and Chamunda Mata Temple. A large number of people visit here from surrounding districts. The express-way will make it easier for devotees visiting here. Wooden items, pottery, and brass products are made in this district. Previously, traders here sold their goods only in Moradabad, Delhi, or local markets. With the commencement of the Ganga Express-way, markets in Shahjahanpur, Lucknow, and Prayagraj will open up. 3 Tehsils of Badaun will be Urbanized The Ganga Expressway is passing through the tehsils of Bisauli, Bilsi, and Dataganj in Badaun. This will increase urbanization in these tehsils. Interchanges have been built in Dataganj and Wazirganj. Due to being along the expressway, compressed biogas plants, LPG bottling plants, food processing units, and cold storages are being built here. Badaun is a major producer of mentha (peppermint). With the start of the expressway, farmers will be able to sell their crops from Delhi to Prayagraj. In the coming time, an industrial corridor is to be built near Dataganj. This will make transportation easier. People of Badaun were dependent on Bareilly for treatment until now, but after the start of the Expressway, they will have the option to go to Lucknow, Meerut, and even Delhi. Sugarcane farmers of Shahjahanpur will benefit An airstrip has been built on a three-and-a-half-kilometer stretch of the Ganga Expressway in Shahjahanpur. It is located in the Jalalabad tehsil area. Last year, 8 fighter jets like Rafale, Jaguar, and Mirage landed here. Now, there are plans to manufacture defense-related items here. Shahjahanpur is known as a sugarcane belt. There are about 4 sugar mills here. These include Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Mill (Tilhar), Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Mill (Maksudaipur), Roza Sugar Mill, and Kesar Enterprises Sugar Mill. The Ganga Expressway will make it easier to send sugar to other states. Nowadays, sugar mills are not only producing sugar but also ethanol. Due to the expressway, ethanol supply to oil company depots will be faster. The airstrip located in Shahjahanpur is near this sugar belt. In the future, if 'cargo facilities' are established here, new avenues will open up for the agricultural products of this region. Land prices in Hardoi increased by up to three times Despite being close to Lucknow, Hardoi district lagged behind in development. This expressway will give it a boost. Interchanges have been built on the expressway at two places in the district - Sandi and Bilgram. This has increased land rates here. Many new hotels, dhabas, petrol pumps, and markets have started to develop. Hardoi has a high production of rice, wheat, and potatoes. Until now, farmers and traders here had limited options to take their produce outside. But now, crops can be transported to other districts more quickly. Industries in Unnao will double Many industries from the industrial city of Kanpur are now shifting to Unnao. The main reason for this is the Ganga Expressway. The UP government is going to develop an industrial corridor along the expressway here. This will benefit the local youth who used to go outside for employment. Despite being located between Lucknow and Kanpur, many parts of Unnao could not be developed. With this expressway, Safipur, Miyaganj, Purwa, Dahi, and Bighapur will be connected to urbanization. This is because interchanges have been built in these areas. Reaching Raebareli AIIMS will be easier There is an AIIMS in Raebareli. Until now, only local people benefited from it. However, with the start of the Ganga Expressway, people from other districts will also be able to get treatment here. The route currently taken by people from Pratapgarh, Prayagraj, and Unnao to reach Raebareli is crowded and jammed. The Ganga Expressway will make the route easier. People traveling from Lucknow to Prayagraj will now be able to go directly from one city to another without entering Raebareli city. Pratapgarh's Amla will also be sold in Delhi Pratapgarh's Amla is famous throughout the country. However, due to lack of proper connectivity, this product was limited to nearby districts. Thanks to the Ganga Expressway, it will be possible to take it to Delhi and sell it. Mango production is also abundant in Pratapgarh. Mango farmers and traders will benefit from this. The Ganga Expressway will lead to the start of real estate and new commercial projects here. Industries will be set up in Soraon-Malaka of Prayagraj The expressway, which starts from Meerut, ends at Judapur Dandu in Prayagraj. Prayagraj city is 25 kilometres away from here. Development will take place here due to the Ganga Expressway. Until now, most industries were in the Naini area, but now they will also be set up in Soraon and Malaka sides. Every year, Magh Mela is held in Prayagraj, Kumbh Mela every 6 years, and Mahakumbh every 12 years. During this period, millions of devotees visit. For people coming from Delhi or the western districts, the Ganga Expressway will be the easiest route. Due to the presence of the Allahabad High Court, it was already a major city. Now it will become even more important.

stories.title: Officer made to do sit-ups calls IAS Association dishonest:Rinku Singh withdraws resignation; says no lure of posting
stories.summary: UP IAS officer Rinku Singh Rahi, who came into the news after doing sit-ups, has withdrawn his resignation. He has submitted a written application to the government for this. When asked about his decision, Rinku Singh said he has no desire for any specific posting and only wants to work. He said the government can assign him work anywhere. He also said that government officials have assured him that such a situation will not happen again. He has been told that he will soon be given a respectful posting. Rinku Singh said- It is wrong to trust the IAS Association. It does not support anyone. The association is the most deceitful. The same thing happened to me as happened to Karna in Mahabharata, just as Karna's earrings were taken away. Rinku Singh Rahi had sent a conditional resignation to the President on March 26. He said that he was getting a salary, but was not getting an opportunity for public service. He had also appealed to be sent back to his old job, i.e., PCS. 44-year-old Rinku was transferred from Shahjahanpur to the Board of Revenue 9 months ago. Since then, he had not received any field posting. Rinku is an IAS officer of the 2021 batch. He still has 16 years of service remaining. Rinku Singh was fired upon on March 26, 2009, during the BSP regime, in which he was hit by seven bullets. Two of these hit his face, disfiguring it. How Rinku Singh was convinced, know here After Rinku's resignation on March 26, there was a stir in the administration. After this, government officials sprang into action. According to sources, an investigation was conducted into Rinku's work during his previous job. His school-college academic documents and caste certificate were also investigated, but no evidence of irregularities was found anywhere. After this, government officials and Anil Kumar, Chairman of the Revenue Council, spoke to Rinku and assured him that his respect would be taken care of in the future. After this, he withdrew his resignation. However, its date has not been revealed. Read exactly what Rinku told Bhaskar after resigning Question - You belong to a Scheduled Caste, did this happen because of that? Rinku: I don't know. I have never thought about this, so I cannot answer. If there were any other officer in my place, they would also have to face this. I want to say that besides the SC caste, there is another caste - the caste of honesty. Honesty is also of two types. One, who only doesn't take money. The other, who works honestly. I am among those who work honestly. Question: You wrote that a parallel system of corruption is running, what is its basis? Rinku: Absolutely right. You must have seen that in many places there is no road, but on paper, the road has been built. This is a system of corruption, which even political people are troubled by. Question: Who is running this system of corruption? Rinku: The bureaucracy itself is running this system of corruption. This system does not work without money. When work is only happening on paper, what does that mean? Question: You haven't received a posting for several months, what do you have to say? Rinku: Perhaps this is the first time since independence that a junior IAS officer has been treated this way. I had already said that if I don't get work, I won't take a salary either. If this happens to a junior IAS officer, what message will it send? I have already faced postings and punishments, but if this happens to a new officer, they will become negative forever. Question- Were you harassed for a posting? Rinku: I was not harassed. I am personally very happy. I am getting time to travel around. I have come to do this job not for personal convenience, but to serve the people. This is a moral issue. My ideals and principles are getting in the way. Read, why Rinku Singh was removed from the SDM post 9 months ago, Rinku Singh Rahi was a Joint Magistrate in Mathura. After being transferred from there, he took charge as Powayan SDM on July 24, 2025, at 2 PM. During this time, he noticed Vijay (38), the clerk of lawyer Agyaram, urinating near the wall inside the premises. He reprimanded him and asked him to use the toilet. The clerk replied to Rinku Singh that the toilets are dirty. At this, the SDM got furious. He started saying that this was the fault of the Tehsil employees. He made the clerk do squats on the spot. Lawyers were protesting in the Tehsil premises regarding some of their demands. Just then, they came to know about the clerk being made to do squats. At this, the lawyers got agitated. They called the SDM to the spot. The SDM told the lawyers that the clerk had made a mistake. At this, the lawyers said that if there is a mistake, then making someone do squats is not right. Can you do squats? At this, Rinku Singh said that there is no shame in it. I can do squats. After this, he did squats 5 times. Know who Rinku Singh Rahi is A resident of Hathras, first became PCS then IAS Rinku Singh Rahi was born on May 20, 1982, in Hathras into a Dalit family. He is a resident of Usva village in Sasni police station area. Rinku, the elder of two brothers, had a father, Saudan Singh Rahi, who supported the family by running a flour mill. Due to the family's weak financial condition, he studied in a government school. After passing 12th grade with good marks, he received a scholarship. With its help, he pursued B.Tech from Tata Institute in Jamshedpur. In 2004, Rinku Singh passed the PCS examination. During his job, he appeared for the UPSC Civil Services examination under the disabled quota. In 2021, he secured the 683rd rank and became an IAS officer. In his family, his wife Sulakha has been a yoga teacher. He has a 10-year-old son, Dhruv Rahi. His paternal uncle, Raghuveer Singh Rahi, was a district president during the BSP regime. He was shot 7 times for exposing corruption After becoming a PCS officer, Rinku Singh's first posting in 2008 was as District Social Welfare Officer in Muzaffarnagar. There, he exposed corruption in scholarships and pensions. Rinku told Dainik Bhaskar - "During the investigation, I found out that 100 crore rupees had been embezzled. Behind this was an entire gang, in addition to a political party." At that time, the BSP government was in power. On March 26, 2009, Rinku was playing badminton with a colleague. Suddenly, two attackers opened fire on him. Rinku Rahi was hit by seven bullets in this. Two of them hit his face. His jaw was dislocated and his face was disfigured. Additionally, one ear was damaged and he lost sight in one eye. Remained hospitalized for a month, staged a protest After this attack, Rinku was taken to a higher center in Meerut. He remained admitted for about a month at Subharti Medical College in Meerut. He returned recovered after the operation. After this, to expose the scam, Rinku sought some information from the department under RTI. However, even after a year, the information was not provided to him. Subsequently, on March 26, 2012, Rinku Rahi started a hunger strike outside the Lucknow Directorate. The police picked up Rinku Rahi from there and sent him to Mental Hospital Lucknow.

stories.title: Yogi announces 1 lakh new police jobs:Openings for home guards, sub inspectors; 936 radio operators get joining letters
stories.summary: CM Yogi announced on Tuesday in Lucknow that 1 lakh new recruitments will be made in UP Police this year. He said - recruitment will be done for Home Guard, Police, and Sub-Inspector posts. The CM distributed joining letters to 936 radio operators. He also took photos with them. The CM said - in the last 9 years, more than 2 lakh 20 thousand policemen have been recruited in a fair manner, which is a record in itself. More than 500 skilled players have been included in the police force. As a result, the state is performing better in national and international competitions. Chief Minister Yogi’s key statements 1. “No need for recommendations for jobs now” The Chief Minister said that just two days ago, 60,000 constables passed out together at 112 centres. This means 60,000 new personnel have joined the UP Police and will now serve actively in the field. He said they have become part of not only the country’s but the world’s largest civil police force, and will serve a population of 25 crore through its communication network. He added that throughout the recruitment process, no candidate needed any recommendation or money. The entire process was completed in a fair and transparent manner, based only on merit, ability and reservation rules. The result is now visible to everyone. 2.“Our aim is to give opportunity to every deserving youth” Yogi said their only goal is to provide opportunities to every capable and deserving young person who wants to join the Uttar Pradesh Police. He said before 2017, there were 10 districts without police lines, and many police stations did not even have proper buildings or basic facilities like barracks. He added that today, old barracks have been replaced with high-rise buildings. Model police stations are being built, new fire stations are being set up, and forces like SSF and SDRF have been formed. Three new women police battalions have also been created. Although three new laws came into force in July 2024, Uttar Pradesh had already prepared for them in advance. The Chief Minister said the State Forensic Institute is now functioning successfully. Keeping the importance of forensic evidence in mind, two mobile forensic labs are working in every district with trained staff, technicians and sample collection teams. 3. “Rule of law is the first guarantee of development” Yogi said this is the story of a new Uttar Pradesh, where the police are not only ensuring a crime-free and riot-free environment but are also contributing to India’s economic growth. He said the police play an indirect but major role because rule of law is the first condition for development. He added that a strong law-and-order system is attracting investors from India and abroad, making it easier to build modern infrastructure. He said when there is strong intent, results naturally follow. The Chief Minister also stressed that every police personnel must remain physically fit, as physical fitness leads to mental strength. Only then can they serve the nation with honesty and dedication. He said communication is a key part of any system, and better communication makes police and security forces stronger and more effective. 4. “There was discrimination in jobs earlier” The Chief Minister said some candidates shared their success stories from the recruitment process, showing they wanted a fair and honest selection. He said the process has been completed transparently, and now it is the responsibility of recruits to perform their duties with the same integrity. He added that India can only progress when every citizen works honestly in their field. No caste, religion or personal interest can be above the nation. He said this was not possible nine years ago. Earlier, recruitment processes were not completed properly, there were allegations of bribery, and discrimination was common. Today, if a person has ability, nothing can stop them from moving forward. This kind of environment has now been created in the state.

stories.title: KGMU doctor sacked over molestation charge:Woman alleges bad touch during ultrasound; attendant removed
stories.summary: A doctor accused of molesting a female patient during an ultrasound at the Urology department of King George’s Medical University (KGMU) has been dismissed from his job. The accused AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy) doctor had been hired by a private agency to operate the ultrasound machine under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model. Initially, officials tried to suppress the matter after the woman filed a complaint. However, following public criticism, the administration set up an inquiry committee. The investigation found the patient’s allegations to be true. After this, both the doctor appointed by the agency and the ward attendant working on an outsourcing basis were removed from their jobs. Officials suppressed the matter for several days A woman residing in Kakori experienced urological problems. On April 1, the female patient arrived at KGMU for treatment. A doctor from the Urology department examined the patient. They advised her to undergo an ultrasound and other tests. The woman went to the Urology department for the ultrasound examination. The victim accused Dr. Shoaib, an AYUSH doctor deployed through an agency, of molestation during the ultrasound. She filed a written complaint with the Head of the Department. For a long time, officials suppressed the matter. The victim continued to lodge complaints. Following this, the KGMU administration formed a 7-member inquiry committee. 7-Member Inquiry Team Submitted Report in 14 Days A team of 7 senior doctors, including Prof. Apul Goyal, Head of the Urology Department, investigated the complaint. During this, it was confirmed that there was no other female staff present at the time of the ultrasound, apart from the doctor. After two weeks of investigation, the team submitted the report to the Vice-Chancellor. Meanwhile, instructions for action were issued from the Vice-Chancellor's office. Under these instructions, the services of the accused and ward staff Savita were terminated. Doctor-Attendant Removed Spokesperson Dr. K.K. Singh stated - Based on the investigation committee's report, the Ayush doctor deployed through an agency has been removed from KGMU. A ward attendant should be present with the female patient during the ultrasound. Negligence was also shown in this. Therefore, the ward attendant on duty has also been removed from service. The PPP Model Game in the Urology Department KGMU has a Radiology department. Approximately 12 regular doctors are deployed in the department. There are more than 40 resident doctors. The department operates ultrasound, CT scan, MRI, X-ray, and other machines. The department is continuously enhancing quality facilities for radiodiagnosis tests. Despite this, the game of operating machines on a PPP model is going on in KGMU. Companies are making huge profits in KGMU. In return, KGMU is receiving a meager commission. In the Urology department too, ultrasound machines have been operated on a PPP model for about 20 years. Who is conducting the tests in these? KGMU administration is not concerned about this.

stories.title: UP voters want renomination of 39 MLAs on caste basis:Thakur, Brahmin lawmakers are top choice
stories.summary: Caste continues to play a decisive role in Uttar Pradesh politics. According to Dainik Bhaskar’s extensive survey, 39 MLAs were preferred by over 50% of respondents for renomination primarily based on caste. Among them, the highest number 11 MLAs belong to the Thakur community, followed by 6 Brahmin MLAs. In third place are Yadav and Kurmi legislators, with 4 MLAs each. The remaining 14 MLAs belong to other caste groups. However, MLAs from Lodhi, Gurjar, and Rajbhar communities were largely rejected by respondents for renomination. Samajwadi Party faces highest rejection among MLAs The survey reveals that 95 MLAs from the Samajwadi Party (SP) were disliked by voters. Among them, 20 are from the Yadav community. Interestingly, even among the 8 SP MLAs who were liked, 4 belonged to the Yadav caste. Majority of MLAs face public disapproval A significant 361 out of 400 MLAs were not preferred for renomination. Among these: Party-wise caste-based rejection trends Caste a key factor in voter perception In 396 out of 400 cases, respondents cited caste as one of the factors influencing their opinion about MLAs. However, caste alone was not the sole reason for rejection. Only 8 MLAs saw caste emerge as a relatively stronger factor in public opinion. Mixed responses for individual MLAs Party preference across caste-based seats Dalit MLAs: Brahmin MLAs: Thakur MLAs: Kurmi MLAs: Yadav MLAs: Other communities Across Lodhi, Jat, Nishad, Gurjar, Maurya, and Rajbhar MLAs, BJP and Samajwadi Party remain the dominant preferred parties, though dissatisfaction with individual MLAs remains high.

stories.title: Jhansi sees heavy rain amid extreme heat:17 districts on storm alert while heatwave warning remains in 35 districts
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh is reeling under extreme heat, with temperatures soaring past 47°C and breaking multiple records over the past 24 hours. Banda emerged as the hottest place in the world, recording a scorching 47.6°C. Previously, the highest temperatures recorded there were 47.4°C on April 30, 2022, and April 25, 2026. Partial Relief as Winds and Rain Activity Begin Despite the intense heat, parts of the state saw some relief on Tuesday morning. Cool winds began blowing across cities like Lucknow and Kanpur, reducing the impact of the harsh sunlight. Late Monday night, Jhansi witnessed heavy rainfall for about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, dust storms swept through Lucknow and Ghaziabad, covering the sky with thick dust clouds. Temperature drops slightly in several regions According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), cooler winds from the eastern direction have caused temperatures to drop by 2–3°C across western and eastern Uttar Pradesh. However, in the Bundelkhand region, temperatures have risen by about 1°C. Storm and Rain Alert in 17 Districts The IMD has issued a warning for thunderstorms, strong winds, and rainfall in 17 districts, including: Wind speeds may reach up to 70 km/h in these areas. See weather pictures In Prayagraj, a laborer was seen unloading earthen pots from a vehicle amidst intense sunlight. Heatwave warning in 35 districts continues Even as rain is expected in several regions, a heatwave alert remains in place for 35 districts, indicating continued extreme weather conditions across the state. Western disturbance to bring further relief Meteorologist Atul Singh from Lucknow said that a new western disturbance has become active, which will trigger a fresh spell of rain accompanied by thunderstorms. He added that temperatures may fall by 2–4°C over the next five days, offering partial relief from heatwave conditions. Weather forecast for the next four days April 29: Widespread rainfall is expected across eastern and western Uttar Pradesh, along with strong winds. Night temperatures are likely to fall. April 30: Rain is likely across the state, with chances of lightning. Hot winds may blow at speeds of up to 40 km/h during the day. May 1: Light rain is expected in western Uttar Pradesh, while eastern regions may receive heavier showers. Thunderstorms and lightning are likely. May 2: Light rainfall may occur in some areas. Strong winds will continue, along with a slight drop in temperature. Mixed conditions: Hot days, warm nights In some parts of the state, heatwave conditions may persist during the day, while nights could also remain unusually warm. However, with the onset of rain and thunderstorms from April 28, temperatures are expected to decline by 2–4°C, improving overall heatwave conditions. Due to the impact of the western disturbance, scattered rainfall activity is likely to begin in western Uttar Pradesh and gradually move toward eastern regions in the coming days.

stories.title: 'Hang your PhD around your neck' yogi taunts Ravikishan:Says, 'This degree won't get you a job', honors Shiksha Mitras in Gorakhpur
stories.summary: CM Yogi Adityanath on Tuesday honoured ‘Shiksha Mitras’ in Gorakhpur, distributing cheques reflecting their increased monthly honorarium of ₹18,000. The programme was held at the Yogiraj Baba Gambhirnath Auditorium. During his address, the Chief Minister took a light-hearted dig at actor and MP Ravi Kishan over his honorary PhD degree. Yogi said Ravi Kishan complained that he had not been congratulated. When asked why, he mentioned receiving a PhD. Yogi clarified that it was an honorary degree and remarked that such a degree does not entitle one to use titles like “Professor” or secure employment on that basis. He jokingly added that the degree could only be displayed, not used professionally, and quipped about the implications if someone with such a title began treating patients. His remarks drew laughter from the audience, and Ravi Kishan responded by standing up and greeting the Chief Minister with folded hands. Yogi later congratulated him for receiving the honorary degree. It is noteworthy that around 1.43 lakh Shiksha Mitras working in Basic Education Council schools in Uttar Pradesh were earlier receiving ₹10,000 per month, which has now been increased to ₹18,000. The revised honorarium has been effective from April. Additionally, CM Yogi is set to dedicate 71 development projects to Gorakhpur. He will inaugurate 26 projects and lay the foundation stone for 45 others, with a total cost of ₹612.31 crore. All the projects are associated with the Gorakhpur Development Authority (GDA).

stories.title: BJP sweeps Bengal polls, Rajbhar targets Akhilesh:Maurya says mandate must be respected, win sparks sharp war of words in Uttar Pradesh politics
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party’s emphatic victory in West Bengal has triggered sharp political reactions in Uttar Pradesh, with leaders using the result to attack rivals and assert growing dominance. The outcome has also energised party workers across the state, who marked the win with public celebrations. Rajbhar targets Akhilesh after Bengal result State minister Om Prakash Rajbhar launched a strong attack on Akhilesh Yadav, calling him a leader confined to social media and comfort zones. He said he had no doubts about the Bengal result and claimed that once Akhilesh publicly backed Mamata Banerjee, her defeat became certain. Rajbhar also wrote on X that Akhilesh’s political career would end after the 2027 Uttar Pradesh elections. Maurya calls mandate supreme Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya said the people’s mandate is final and must be respected. He criticised opposition leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and M. K. Stalin, accusing them of ignoring public sentiment. He added that politics based on confusion is fading and warned that those disrespecting electoral verdicts would not be forgiven by history. Celebrations across Uttar Pradesh Party workers across several cities celebrated the victory with enthusiasm: Leaders join celebrations in Lucknow In Lucknow, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath distributed sweets before a cabinet meeting. Deputy Chief Ministers Brajesh Pathak and Keshav Maurya were seen sharing snacks at the party office. Workers raised slogans praising the leadership and showcased symbolic displays reflecting the party’s governance image. BJP expands footprint across states The results from five states have significantly strengthened the BJP’s position: Mamata Banerjee also lost her own election, marking a significant political shift. Why Bengal result matters for 2027 Political observers say the Bengal and Assam victories have boosted BJP morale and created new challenges for the Samajwadi Party-Congress alliance. Akhilesh Yadav’s focus on the PDA (backward, Dalit, minority) strategy now faces fresh scrutiny. Questions are being raised within political circles: How opposition unity will hold ahead of the 2027 elections Leaders, meanwhile, continue to frame the result as proof of public trust in governance and strategy led by Prime Minister Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah, underlining a widening political divide as the next electoral battle approaches.

stories.title: UP to get permanent DGP in 15 days:Rajeev Krishna leads race; Renuka also in contention
stories.summary: A hearing is scheduled in the Supreme Court on May 19 regarding the appointment of a permanent DGP in UP. Activity around this has intensified. According to senior officials, the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) will send a list of top-3 IPS officers to the UP government within 15 days. Rajeev Krishna's name will also be included in it. Renuka Mishra, Piyush Anand, Alok Sharma, Rajeev Krishna, and PC Meena are in the top-5. Among these, Renuka Mishra is from the 1990 batch, while all others are from the 1991 batch. According to seniority, Rajeev Krishna comes at number four. However, Alok Sharma will retire in June 2026. The UP government has not considered Renuka Mishra suitable for the post. She faces allegations of negligence in the 2024 constable recruitment examination. Only Piyush Anand from his own batch who is on central deputation remains senior to Rajeev Krishna now. Now the question is, will Rajeev Krishna become the permanent DGP or someone else? If Rajeev Krishna is appointed, how long can he remain DGP? Which other officers are eligible for DGP? Rajeev Krishna is ahead in the race to become DGP Rajeev Krishna has been the acting DGP of UP since June 1, 2025. He took charge after Prashant Kumar's retirement on May 31 last year. He became the acting DGP by superseding 11 IPS officers. Except for Renuka Mishra, Piyush Anand, and Alok Sharma, all officers have retired. Rajeev Krishna has an image of being strict and among the officers close to the CM. It is likely that UPSC will send Rajeev Krishna's name in its panel of three names. After that, he will be made the permanent DGP of the state. If Rajiv Krishna becomes permanent DGP, will remain in post for 3 yrs According to Supreme Court directives, if an IPS officer becomes a permanent DGP, their tenure will be at least 2 years. After that, the state government will make a decision. Rajiv Krishna is a 1991 batch IPS officer. His retirement date is June 30, 2029. According to this, he can remain in this post till 2029. Alok Sharma is retiring in June According to UPSC guidelines, IPS officers who have less than 6 months of service remaining will not be considered. The state government has considered the date of vacancy for the current DGP post as the date on which the Supreme Court issued a new order for the permanent appointment of the DGP. This order was issued on February 5. Alok Sharma's retirement is on June 30, 2026. Due to this, he has been eliminated from the race to become DGP. Renuka Mishra's name may be considered 1990 batch IPS Renuka Mishra has not been in any post for a long time. In a letter sent to UPSC on March 16, 2026, the UP government said that Renuka Mishra was the Chairman of Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board from February 14, 2023, to March 5, 2024. During this period, the constable recruitment examination was held. On February 24, 2024, the examination paper was leaked. After this, the written exam was cancelled. Investigation revealed that the recruitment board had assigned the responsibility of printing the paper to a blacklisted firm. Renuka Mishra was held responsible for this negligence, and she was removed from the recruitment board. However, UPSC can still consider their name, as the government has not taken any punitive action against Renuka Mishra so far. This means that on paper, they are still 'clean'. If UPSC considers Renuka Mishra, then Piyush Anand will be in the second position after them. Piyush is posted as DG in NDRF on Central Deputation. At the third position is the current Acting DGP Rajeev Krishna. If Renuka is not in the panel, then the name of 1991 batch IPS DG Jail PC Meena will be included as the third officer. 5 Acting DGPs in 4 years UP has not had a permanent DGP for the past 4 years. On May 11, 2022, the government removed permanent DGP Mukul Goyal. Since then, the state has only had acting DGPs. After Mukul Goyal's removal, DS Chauhan was made acting DGP. After him, RK Vishwakarma, Vijay Kumar, and Prashant Kumar were made acting DGPs. After them, Rajeev Krishna is the acting DGP.

stories.title: 5 dead, including 4 policemen from Jalaun:Scorpio collides with another vehicle on KMP Expressway
stories.summary: Five people, including four police personnel from Jalaun in Uttar Pradesh, were killed in a road accident on an expressway in Nuh, Haryana, at around 10:30 am on Tuesday. The deceased include two sub-inspectors, two constables and a driver. Reports said the police team had gone to act in a kidnapping case and met with an accident while returning. Eyewitnesses said the driver tried to overtake on the expressway when the vehicle went out of control and crashed heavily into another vehicle moving ahead. The accident took place near the Dhulawat toll plaza on the Kundli-Manesar-Palwal (KMP) Expressway. After the crash, all five victims were found trapped inside the vehicle. Police had to make significant efforts to pull out the bodies. The four police personnel were posted at Orai police station in Jalaun. They have been identified as sub-inspectors Mohit Yadav and Satyabhan, and constables Ashok and Pradeep. The identity of the driver is yet to be confirmed. 3 pictures after the accident Vehicle registered with Jind RTO The black Scorpio vehicle in which the police personnel were travelling was registered at the RTO in Jind, Haryana. The front portion of the vehicle was badly damaged in the accident. Police recovered a Uttar Pradesh Police ID card from the spot, which belonged to Sub-Inspector Mohit Yadav. What exactly happened? The accident took place at around 10 am on Tuesday near the Dhulawat toll plaza on the Kundli–Manesar–Palwal (KMP) Expressway in Haryana. According to information, the police team was returning from Nuh district after conducting a raid in a Scorpio vehicle. While attempting to overtake, the vehicle went out of control and crashed into a vehicle ahead. The impact was so severe that the Scorpio was completely wrecked and all five personnel died on the spot. Identification of the deceased personnel The police personnel who lost their lives include Sub-Inspector Mohit Yadav (from Kannauj), Sub-Inspector Satyabhan (from Kasganj), Constable Ashok Kumar (from Banda), Constable Pradeep from the surveillance team, and the driver. The driver’s identity is yet to be confirmed. All were posted in the Orai police station area. Team had gone to probe kidnapping case The operation was linked to a kidnapping case. Amreek Singh, a resident of Sangrur in Punjab, had filed a complaint on 4 May at Orai police station stating that his cousin Bijender Singh had been abducted over a dispute involving 32 acres of land. The Special Operations Group (SOG) team had gone to Haryana to investigate the case and recover the victim. Kidnapping from tubewell room According to the complaint, Bijender Singh was abducted by four unidentified men while he was sleeping in a tubewell room on the morning of 4 May. During the incident, the complainant’s mobile phone was also snatched. The family initially tried to search for him on their own but later approached the police after failing to find him. SP confirms the incident Jalaun SP Vinay Kumar Singh confirmed the accident and said that a case (No. 256/26) had been registered at Orai police station. He added that the team had gone to Haryana to recover the abducted man. Further legal action is being taken in coordination with Haryana Police, and the families have been informed. Details about the deceased personnel Sub-Inspector Satyabhan (eldest among five brothers) Satyabhan was a native of Alipur Dadar village in Kasganj district. He was one of five brothers. One brother, Satyaveer, lives in the village and farms, while two others, Kirat and Badal Singh, live in Agra. Another brother, Gurdev, is posted as a revenue official in Jhansi. He had been living with his family in the Badhpur area between Fatehgarh and Farrukhabad. His wife’s name is Atar Kali. He had five children—three sons and two daughters. His eldest son, Manjeet (26), is married. His other sons are Vishal (23) and Babu (18). His daughters, Anandi (30) and Poonam (28), are both married. Constable Ashok Kumar Ashok Kumar was the youngest in his family and the second son. His elder brother Indrajeet has been living separately from the family for the past seven years. His father, Gulab, died of a heart attack about a month ago. He had three sisters, all of whom are married—Laxmi (38), Rekha (35), and Sushila (33). Station In-charge said - Bodies sent to hospital Tauru Sadar Police Station in-charge Sheeshram said, The police and rescue team had to struggle a lot to pull out all five bodies. Ambulances were called to the spot and the bodies were sent for post-mortem. It is being investigated where all five were going.

stories.title: Family refuses to bury killer shot down in encounter:Accused had murdered 4 children and their mother in Ambedkar Nagar
stories.summary: In Ambedkar Nagar, UP, the family refused to bury the body of Aamir, the murderer of a woman and four children. The Imam also refused to recite the Fatiha at the grave. The police prepared to bury the body themselves. However, late at night, the family agreed to take the body. They buried Aamir in the village cemetery. Actually, on Monday morning, the police shot down 19-year-old Aamir in an encounter. He had murdered a woman and her four children on May 2. He wanted to marry the woman and grab her land, but she had refused. Angered by this, he committed the crime. The case is from the Muradabad area of Akbarpur Kotwali. After the encounter on Monday, police conducted Aamir's post-mortem. The body was sent to his home. Upon seeing the body, family members said they have no relation with Aamir anymore. What he did was against humanity. Then police called the local imam and Aamir's uncle, Taj Mohammad, to recite Fatiha at the grave, but he also refused. He said that we have no sympathy for Aamir, which is why the family is refusing to take his body. They cannot participate in the funeral of a criminal. In such a situation, they will neither participate in Aamir's burial nor will they take part in his last rites. The action taken by the police is correct. SP Prachi Singh stated- Initially, the family members were refusing to bury the deceased's body, but later due to social pressure, the family members themselves performed the last rites. Aamir set trap after committing 5 murders In the Meeranpur locality of Akbarpur police station area, Aamir (19) had murdered 4 children and their mother on May 2 (Saturday). On May 4 (Monday), the police had gunned down Aamir in an encounter. CO Nitish Tiwari had stated that, based on the woman's family members' account, the woman's husband lives in Saudi Arabia. He has married a Pakistani woman there. Therefore, Aamir wanted to marry the woman and usurp her land, but she refused. On May 2, the enraged Aamir assaulted the woman and her children, causing the woman to lose consciousness. After this, the accused killed all four children. During this time, the woman regained consciousness and started screaming, so the accused killed her too. After this, he dragged the woman's body about 200 meters and threw it in a drain. The accused did this to mislead the police, so that it would appear that the woman had killed her own children. This is exactly what happened, and the police fell into his trap. The police who arrived after the incident had suspected that the mother had killed the children and fled. However, on May 3, that is Sunday, when the body of the woman Gausiya was found in the drain, the police's theory was completely overturned. Injury marks were found on her body. The police started investigating the murder angle. During the investigation, Aamir's name came up. When police surrounded, accused opened fire, bullet hit in retaliatory action SP Prachi Singh had informed that on Sunday night, police received information that the accused Aamir was present near Newtariya Bypass. He was looking for an opportunity to escape. A cordon was laid to catch him. During this, a suspicious person was seen coming on a bike at dawn. When signaled to stop, he turned the bike and started fleeing. While fleeing, the bike skidded. She said that he started firing at the police. In retaliatory action, a bullet hit his chest. Police took him to the district hospital, where doctors declared him dead. During the encounter, a bullet hit the bulletproof jacket of the SOG in charge, Vinod Yadav. One inspector and one constable were also injured. Police recovered a bike, a pistol, and empty cartridges from the spot. Bodies of 4 children found on May 2, mother reported missing

stories.title: Smart meter bills to be issued like postpaid:Yogi govt ends prepaid system, bans conversion of old meters
stories.summary: Amidst growing outrage and controversy over smart prepaid meters in UP, the Yogi government has given major relief to 70 lakh electricity consumers. The prepaid system has been discontinued in the state. Now all smart meters will function like postpaid meters. This means the prepaid system (recharge first) arrangement is being eliminated. Consumers will again receive monthly bills. The facility to deposit arrears in installments will also be provided. The Energy Minister has given instructions that electricity should not be disconnected within a month under any circumstances, and complaints should be resolved on priority. Energy Minister AK Sharma said, The customer is God. This decision has been taken keeping in view technical difficulties and consumer complaints, so that people can get relief. Smart meters have been facing opposition in the state for several months. On April 25, the Energy Minister had said that electricity would not be disconnected for connections up to 1 kilowatt for 30 days and for 2 kilowatts even after a deduction of ₹200. Even after this, people's anger did not subside. On Sunday, women took to the streets in several cities, including Agra, Firozabad, and Fatehpur. They uprooted meters from homes and threw them at the electricity department offices. SP and Aam Aadmi Party also held demonstrations. On Monday, Energy Minister AK Sharma held an important meeting with electricity department officials at Shakti Bhawan. He discussed the ongoing protests in the state with the officials. Considering the problems arising from smart/prepaid meters, Minister Sharma said, I had said earlier that consumers will not have to face any trouble. Now all smart meters in the state will function like normal post-paid meters. The system called pre-paid has been completely abolished. These decisions were taken Why did the govt have to discontinue the prepaid system? Electricity consumers say that smart meters run very fast. This results in higher bills even with less usage. Sometimes the balance decreases even without usage. As soon as the balance goes into minus, the electricity supply gets disconnected. Even after a recharge, the supply is often not restored immediately. On Sunday, protests were held in Agra, Prayagraj, Kanpur, Lucknow, Fatehpur, and Varanasi regarding smart meters. In Fatehpur, electricity consumers uprooted smart meters and threw them at the power house. In Agra, women uprooted smart meters from their homes and threw them on the streets. They said, " We don't want smart meters, we want the old meters''. Since the installation of smart meters, electricity bills have been getting higher. Money is being deposited in advance. Even after depositing money, electricity is being cut. When inquired, they say the balance is in minus. A protest had taken place here three days ago as well. Scuffle with police in Lucknow In Lucknow, the AAP party held a strong protest. AAP workers reached Shakti Bhavan carrying posters and placards in their hands. They started moving towards the Assembly while raising slogans against the BJP government. The police stopped the protesters near Shriram Tower. The protesters insisted on moving forward. This led to a sharp confrontation with the police. The police took them into custody. They were dragged and put into vehicles and taken to Eco Garden. Pratipal Singh, who participated in the protest, has alleged that his turban was pulled off to humiliate him. AAP spokesperson in Varanasi said will continue to protest Aam Aadmi Party had staged a protest against smart meters at the Chaukaghat electricity substation in Varanasi. Spokesperson Mukesh Singh had said that common people are being harassed by smart meters. We will continue to protest against it at all costs. Because its bill is being taken arbitrarily. The government should stop it immediately, because it is cheating people in a smart way.

stories.title: Minister OP Rajbhar’s gunner accused of raping woman:Allegedly exploited her for 4 years, forced abortions, secretly married another woman
stories.summary: Police have arrested Prashant Rai (29), the gunner of Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar, on charges of repeatedly raping a woman over four years and forcing her to undergo abortions. The constable allegedly lived with the woman in a rented room. According to the complaint, when the woman became pregnant, he got her abortion done and, on the pretext of marriage, made her pregnant again. Over four years, he also took money from her on several occasions and allegedly assaulted her and attempted to harm her life. Despite being in a relationship with the woman, the constable secretly married another woman in Prayagraj on April 25. Even after taking leave for the wedding, he remained in contact with the victim. The matter came to light when the woman received photos of his wedding through a social media contact. When she confronted Prashant Rai, he allegedly tried to mislead her again and promised to continue living with her. Following this, the victim approached the Sarnath police station on May 4 and lodged a complaint, after which a case was registered. After questioning at the Sarnath police station in Varanasi, the accused constable was arrested and will be produced in court. Background of the case Prashant Rai, son of Trilok Narayan Rai and a resident of Chandragarh in Drumandganj, Mirzapur, joined the police force eight years ago and is currently posted in Ghazipur. After serving in the police lines and various police stations, he was assigned as the gunner of Cabinet Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar. The accused had rented a room in Benipur under the Sarnath police station limits in Varanasi. During his service, he developed a relationship with a woman from the Ajgara police station area. He began visiting her home, but her family objected due to caste differences. Following this, the woman started living with him in Sarnath. The woman alleged that she had been in a relationship with the constable for four years and had been living with him as his wife for the past two years. She became pregnant twice. About six months ago, when she conceived, the accused took her to Mirzapur and pressured her to undergo an abortion, saying that having a child without marriage would create problems. After some disputes, she became pregnant again two months ago. During this period, Prashant allegedly fixed his marriage elsewhere and, after the woman conceived again, married another woman in Prayagraj. Marriage exposed through photos On May 1, the woman learned about his marriage through photos on social media. When she called him, he gave evasive replies and cited circumstances and family pressure. He promised to come to Sarnath to resolve the matter. However, the victim approached the police on May 4 and submitted a written complaint, seeking action against him. The police called the constable for questioning. He arrived at Sarnath police station along with his elder brother, Kamal Narayan Rai. During interrogation, the police confronted him with questions and photographs with the victim. He reportedly got entangled in his statements and confessed to the crime. Call Detail Records (CDR) were also presented as evidence, following which he was arrested. After the arrest, he will be produced in court. The police have also informed the Police Commissioner and the concerned district authorities, recommending his suspension and departmental action. Further investigation is underway. Went on leave for marriage Sarnath SHO Pankaj Rai said the accused constable was posted in Ghazipur and had been on leave for the past few days to get married in his hometown in Mirzapur. Upon receiving the complaint, an inquiry confirmed the allegations, and he was called to the police station and subsequently arrested. He had applied for leave for his wedding a few days earlier. During his absence, another gunner was temporarily assigned to the minister, and since he did not return, his official deployment was not resumed.

stories.title: Weather department predicts storm in UP in next 3 hours:Drizzle in Lucknow; alert in 42 districts; 7 deaths within 24 hours
stories.summary: 7 people have died in the last 24 hours due to storms and rain in UP. On Tuesday as well, a storm and rain alert has been issued for 42 districts of the state. Drizzling has started in Lucknow. Clouds are hovering over Barabanki, Sitapur, and Raebareli. Strong winds are blowing. The Meteorological Department has issued a warning that within the next 3 hours, there will be rain along with storms in many places across the state. Lightning may also strike. Therefore, remain alert on the roads. Talking about Monday, hailstones fell in Ayodhya, Sitapur, and Barabanki. Rain occurred after storms in 22 districts, including Varanasi and Kanpur. The highest rainfall was recorded in Sambhal at 130 mm, while Kasganj remained second with 97 mm of rainfall. Due to bad weather in Lucknow, the flights of Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak and Keshav Maurya could not land. After this, the aircraft landed in Bhopal. In Pilibhit, a 100-foot-high chimney of a brick kiln collapsed. In accidents related to storms and rain, 2 children died in Kasganj, a grandmother and granddaughter in Auraiya, 2 men in Gorakhpur, and a girl child in Sambhal lost their lives. Lucknow weather scientist Atul Singh said- The weather has changed due to the effect of western disturbance. There is a possibility of rain, storms and lightning in the state for the next few days. Between May 4 to 7, strong winds can blow at a speed of 40 to 60 km per hour. Hail may also fall. There is no possibility of heat waves for the next one week. Crops damaged due to rain, Yogi says, ‘Officers should go to field’ The spell of rain has been continuing in UP for the past 5 days, which has caused damage to crops. Vegetable crops have been particularly affected. Cucumber, melon, and watermelon are feared to have suffered the most damage. CM Yogi Adityanath said that the government stands with the farmers. Officials should go to the field and survey the damage, and submit the report as soon as possible, so that compensation can be given. No kind of negligence will be tolerated in this. What will the weather be like for the next 5 days? May 6: Clouds are likely to remain overcast across the state. Rain may occur at some places. Winds will blow at a speed of 30-40 km. May 7: Weather will remain clear in Western UP. Showers may occur with thunderstorms in Eastern UP. There is also a possibility of a hailstorm. May 8: Showers will occur with thunder and lightning across the state. Dust storms may occur in some places. There will be relief from the heat wave. May 9: Weather will remain normal across the state. Rain may occur at some places. Winds will blow at a speed of 30-40 km. May 10: Showers may occur once again with thunder and lightning in the state. Dust storms will occur in some places, and relief from the heat wave will continue.

stories.title: 5 key messages for UP from Bengal-Assam results:Akhilesh faces double challenge; hard to win relying on core vote bank alone
stories.summary: The resounding victory of the BJP in Assam and West Bengal has intensified the political activity in UP. While the BJP's morale has been boosted, the SP-Congress alliance is facing a new challenge. The election results have clearly indicated that strong leadership and a clear strategy will deliver victory in the 2027 UP elections. What signals is the Bengal victory giving for UP? Will SP still give a tough competition in the main contest, or will BJP register a big victory for the third time? Which formula from Bengal-Assam will work in UP as well? Read this report Bengal Election results give 5 messages 1. BJP will make Hindutva more vocal: BJP will adopt a more aggressive strategy in UP. Along with Hindutva, development issues like highways, airports, and industrial corridors will be important. 2. Dual challenge for SP: Akhilesh Yadav will now have to deal not only with the BJP, but also with the internal conflicts of the INDI alliance. Congress is not ready to agree to less than 100 seats. SP does not want to give more than 50. 3. Difficult to win relying on a specific vote bank: In UP, the Yadav-Muslim vote bank is with SP. BJP is focused on consolidating non-Yadav OBCs. In such a situation, both parties will need votes from every section. 4. BJP is capitalizing on the women's reservation issue: In Bengal elections, women prioritized security and development. By opposing the Women's Bill, SP has already made the same mistake as Trinamool Congress (TMC). BJP is also making this an issue. 5. Akhilesh following Mamata's path for minorities: In Bengal, TMC chose the path of appeasement for minority votes, which backfired on them. SP has also raised the demand for a separate reservation for Muslim women during the Women's Bill. BJP will make efforts to achieve a hat-trick in UP In 2027, BJP will make efforts to gain power in UP for the third time, while the SP-Congress alliance will try to defeat the BJP like in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. Now the question is, will it be so easy to defeat the BJP in UP, which has brought about a change of power in Bengal and returned to power for the third consecutive time in Assam? SP is the main opposition party in UP. Akhilesh Yadav is continuously talking about PDA (Backward, Dalit, Minority), but the defeat in Bengal has increased pressure on SP. If a strong party like TMC can lose in Bengal, then how long will SP survive in UP? Just as the BJP raised issues of Ram Mandir, CAA, and economic reforms in Bengal, similarly, Ram Path, expressways, investment, and UP's development will be pushed forward in UP. Senior journalist Suresh Bahadur Singh says that by forming government for the third time in two out of five states and snatching Bengal from TMC, BJP's morale is high. Workers are enthusiastic. Certainly, BJP will benefit from this in the UP Assembly elections to be held next year. Bengal election results are a lesson for SP Trinamool Congress did not form an electoral alliance with any major party in Bengal. Congress fought alone there and could win only 2 seats. It did not perform particularly well in Assam and Tamil Nadu either. Earlier, Congress could not do anything remarkable in the Bihar elections as well. However, the SP-Congress alliance gave a tough fight to the BJP in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections in UP. In the Assembly elections, BJP will have to find an answer to the SP-Congress alliance. Senior journalist Rajendra Kumar says that the Bengal election results are a lesson for SP. It will have to take to the streets with people's issues. Just press conferences won't work. If you contest elections based on people's problems, the public will crown you in the first attempt itself, like in Tamil Nadu, otherwise there won't be a return to power even on the third attempt, like in Assam. Need to contain anti-incumbency wave According to Rajendra Kumar, there was an anti-incumbency wave against TMC, which had been in power for 15 years in West Bengal. People were troubled by its misgovernance. Currently, an anti-incumbency wave is not visible in UP, but two incidents alert the government. First- The Noida workers' movement exposed the government. Governments of states like Haryana found a solution in time, but the UP government woke up only after the movement. The second issue is the outrage against smart meters. Women are protesting by uprooting smart meters at various places. This is the pain of every household. The smart meter and electricity issue affects voters. The Energy Minister has tried to do damage control. He has said that now all smart meters will work like postpaid meters. That is, the prepaid system (recharge first) arrangement is being eliminated. Muslim appeasement will become a major weapon in UP too Senior journalist Suresh Bahadur Singh says that the BJP had accused Congress and TMC of Muslim appeasement in Bengal-Assam. Because of this, it succeeded in uniting Hindus. In UP too, SP has been continuously accused of Muslim appeasement. During the special session of the Lok Sabha, SP had raised the demand for reservation for Muslim women during the discussion on the Women's Reservation Amendment Bill. In such a situation, Muslim appeasement will be the BJP's important issue against the opposition during the UP elections. The elections in Assam, Tamil Nadu, and Bengal have made it clear that the politics of appeasement of a particular section and opposition to Sanatan is not going to work anymore. SP will have to think about this once again. Women's schemes can be game changers for BJP The women factor works in favor of the BJP's repeat governments. Women are voting for the BJP in large numbers. On the strength of women's security and development, BJP has become the first choice of half the population. Like in Bihar, in Assam too, the BJP gave ₹8-8 thousand as Bihu gifts to 37 lakh women included in the 'Arunodoi Scheme'. In Bengal, the BJP promised to give women ₹3K cash every month. Now, the mobilization and voting by women voters is also being cited as a major reason behind its victory. The UP government will also have to bring a similar kind of scheme. CM Yogi will have to draw a bigger line than Himanta According to senior journalist Rajendra Kumar, in Assam, CM Himanta Biswa Sarma single-handedly gave the BJP power for the third time. He came to the BJP from Congress. In Assam, PM Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah held only one rally each. CM Yogi also campaigned on two assembly seats in a single day. There, Himanta had single-handedly held the fort. Now CM Yogi Adityanath will face a similar challenge in UP. BJP's National President Nitin Nabin has already spoken in an interview about contesting elections on Yogi Adityanath's face. In such a situation, CM Yogi will now have to single-handedly secure a massive third-time victory for the BJP in UP and draw a bigger line than Assam.

stories.title: Suspended JE climbs 30-foot tower in protest:Demands reinstatement before coming down; officials negotiate for over 3 hours
stories.summary: In Prayagraj, Junior Engineer (JE) Abhay Kumar Yadav, upset over his suspension, climbed a 30-foot high tower on Thursday evening. Police and electricity department officials have been trying to persuade him for about two and a half hours, but Abhay is not ready to come down. Abhay is repeatedly shouting from the tower, saying, "I will not come down until I am reinstated." Engineer Abhay was suspended a day earlier after the death of a lineman. The JE stated that he was on duty until 2:30 AM on April 28 and returned home after restoring the power supply. After this, a government lineman called a private lineman to carry out repair work. During this, the power supply was switched on, and the private lineman died due to electrocution. The JE alleges that he was suspended without his side of the story being heard. Police force is deployed at the spot, and efforts are being made to bring him down. See 3 pictures Accused of taking one-sided action Employees say that upon receiving information about the incident, they themselves reached the spot and took Ramu to the hospital, but he died there. Fellow employees also say that no information was given by Abhay about Ramu being made to climb the pole. Despite this, one-sided action was taken against them.

stories.title: Bride killed as tanker crushes head, remains gathered in scarf:4 die in Shahjahanpur crash; car wrecked while family returned after farewell
stories.summary: In Shahjahanpur, on Thursday afternoon, 4 people, including the bride, died in an accident. The family was bringing the bride home after her farewell from her maternal home. But on the way, a tanker hit the car. The collision was so powerful that the car overturned several times and was completely wrecked. Parts were scattered on the road. Upon receiving information, the police arrived. Nearby people pulled out the people trapped in the car. The bride's entire head was crushed. Lumps of flesh were protruding out. The pieces of flesh were collected in the same 'chunari' (scarf) that the bride had worn for her farewell. Among the deceased, besides the bride, are her sister-in-law (husband's sister), aunt (father's sister), and brother-in-law (husband's younger brother). Meanwhile, the father-in-law and two children are injured. The accident occurred about 60 km from the district headquarters. Police have taken the injured to the hospital. With four deaths simultaneously in the family, the wedding joys have turned into mourning. The wedding took place on April 25, father-in-law was bringing her back after the farewell today The bride Kalpana (22 years old) was a resident of Pipariya Bhagwant village in Khutar police station area. Her wedding took place on April 25 with Rawil Verma, a resident of Agona Buzurg village in Puwayan police station area. The distance between the two villages is about 25 km. Two days after the wedding, Kalpana's parents took her back to her maternal home for the farewell ceremony. On Thursday morning, her father-in-law Anil Kumar went to her maternal home in a car to bring his daughter-in-law Kalpana back. They were returning in the afternoon. Seven people were in the car. These included Anil's daughter Mohini (14), sister Reena Devi (30) wife of Karmadev, her two children Abhiransh (6), Animesh (5), and the driver Nirdosh. Nirdosh was Anil's nephew. Nepali tanker hit from the front On Thursday afternoon, around 1:30 PM, near Rautapur Kala village in Khutar police station area, a speeding oil tanker hit a car head-on. The tanker was Nepali and was heading in that direction. The collision was so severe that the car was badly damaged and overturned. After the accident, there was a lot of screaming. When people from nearby areas rushed to the scene, the tanker driver abandoned the vehicle and fled. Bride's jewelry removed, body sent to mortuary People informed the police about the accident and started pulling out those trapped in the car. Kalpana's head was split open and her dupatta lay beside her. Anil's daughter Mohini also lay beside her. Both had died on the spot. Reena Devi and driver Nirdosh were in critical condition and were taken to the hospital. Both died during treatment there. Father-in-law Anil sustained a head injury. Animesh and Abhiransh are also injured. Police have sent the bodies for post-mortem. Before placing them in body bags, family members were seen crying and wailing as they removed the bride's jewelry. Whoever witnessed this scene became emotional. See 3 pictures related to the accident Husband went to Kannauj to take an exam Kalpana's husband, Ravil Verma, is graduating from Kannauj. On Thursday, he did not go for the farewell. He had gone to take an exam. Information about the incident has been given. SP Rural Diksha Bhavre said, “Information was received by PRV that a Tata Punch car was hit by a speeding tanker. Four people have died in this. The injured have been referred to Kheri District Hospital. Further legal action is being taken.”

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav asks why bulldozer action missing in Hardoi:Accuses BJP of being anti-women; demands justice for Shilpi murder
stories.summary: In the Shilpi murder case that occurred in Hardoi, Akhilesh Yadav met with the family members. He gave the family a check for 5 lakh rupees and demanded a CBI investigation. Akhilesh said that in every incident, the government conducts bulldozer and 'Langda Operation' through the police administration. But why is it backing down here? While talking to the media, the SP chief said that BJP is anti-women. They themselves don't want to pass the Women's Reservation Bill. We had landed planes on the expressway in 2016, they are landing them now. The Agra Expressway that we built is better than the Ganga Expressway. Actually, on April 13, Shilpi Kushwaha was murdered. Akhilesh Yadav reached Garhi Rasulpur village in Mallawan Kotwali area around 12 noon on Thursday. Before his arrival, the police had made tight security arrangements. After meeting Shilpi's family members, Akhilesh left for Lucknow. Read Akhilesh Yadav's 3 major points... 1. In Kannauj, gangsters are imposed within 10 minutes What did the supremacist people do with the Maurya daughter in Fatehpur? Similarly, a daughter lost her life in Pratapgarh. What happened with the daughter in Ghazipur? And if the police had taken action in Ghazipur, that daughter would not have lost her life. There, when our people were going to meet the daughter's family, these supremacist people stood with stones. Gangster action is also pending against the accused, father-son have gone to jail, is an attempt being made to give it a caste angle. On this question, Akhilesh said sarcastically that find out in our Kannauj, they apply Gangster Act in 10 minutes. They demolish houses with bulldozers in 10 minutes. How far is Kannauj from here? Akhilesh said that the Prime Minister probably doesn't know about this? What is the caste angle in this, if something happens to you, are we not with you? 2. Why hasn't bulldozer action been taken yet If injustice has been done to someone, then will we not stand with them? In this case, father and son have already gone to jail. The police are constantly talking about taking action. But the question is that the government runs bulldozers at other places, why is it not helping here? You have given crores of rupees at other places, then why is this family not being helped? Shilpi's brother Dhirendra said - Sir, we want justice. Our toilet and boundary have been demolished. Those people want to intimidate us. Neither are the criminals being caught nor is any strict action being taken against them. We want a CBI investigation and the criminals should be hanged. On this, Akhilesh said that I am in favor of all your demands. We will provide all possible legal help. 3. BJP government is learning from us Meanwhile, regarding the Ganga Expressway, he said that I have just come driving on the expressway built by them. I thought I would see how it has been built. He said that even now, the expressway built by us is better. The BJP government is learning from us. We had landed planes on the road in 2016, they are now practicing it. Now what Shilpi's mother and brother say Brother said, ‘Asked CM for help, no action was taken’ Shilpi's brother said that we had also given a memorandum to the Chief Minister, but there was no hearing. We have been wandering for justice for years. We kept folding our hands to save our daughter, but no one listened. Neither the SP sir, nor the station officer, nor the CO or DM sir. On this, Akhilesh said that this is why I had created 1090 (Women's Helpline). There should be such a system through which women and daughters can get immediate help. Strict action must be taken against the culprits. Mother said, 'Bulldozers should run at the accused's place' Shilpi's mother said that those criminals should be hanged, a bulldozer should be run on their house and whatever land they have should be auctioned. And there should be a CBI investigation, whoever is involved in it should also be punished equally. Shilpi was murdered on April 13 On the evening of April 13, Shilpi Kushwaha (26) was going to throw garbage from her house, when Rishabh Dwivedi from the same village attacked her with a spade and killed her. Based on the complaint of Shilpi's father Ram Rahis, a murder case was registered against the accused Rishabh and his father Pramod. Police arrested the accused Rishabh on April 15. After this, his father Pramod was also arrested on April 19 and sent to jail. Rishabh had told the police that he had an affair with Shilpi. Due to this, Shilpi's husband had left her. Rishabh suspected that Shilpi had started talking to someone else, which is why he committed the murder. Some inflammatory comments related to this murder case had surfaced on social media, on which a case was registered against 12 named and 10 unknown accused on the complaint of Sub Inspector Shyam Bahadur. Earlier, on April 23, a delegation of SP was going to meet Shilpi's family members, which was stopped near Sandila. On the night of April 22, several SP workers in the district were also placed under house arrest. In this matter, SP Ashok Kumar Meena suspended Mallawan Kotwal Shivakant Pandey on April 28.

stories.title: Family of 4 killed in Shahjahanpur crash:Speeding Bolero hits bike taking shortcut on highway; both children suffer fatal head injuries
stories.summary: In Shahjahanpur, a husband, wife, and their two children lost their lives while trying to take a shortcut on the highway. A Bolero and a bike collided head-on. The husband and wife got dragged under the Bolero. The collision was so severe that the daughter and son were thrown 10 feet away. Both their heads were split open. People present at the scene of the accident reported that the bike rider had entered the overbridge from the wrong side. The Bolero was speeding at over 100 kmph. Due to this, its driver could not control the vehicle and the accident occurred. The incident happened on Thursday morning around 11 AM near DPS School, 35 km away from the district headquarters. 2 pictures of the accident The Complete Accident in Detail Arun, a resident of Ramnagar Bagiya village in Nigohi police station area, had gotten married 14 years ago. He worked a private job. On Wednesday, his brother-in-law Sarvjeet's wedding was taking place. He had gone to his in-laws' place in Silkhari village, Puwayan, on a Splendor Plus bike (UP 27-BV-3343) with his wife and both children. During this time, his daughter Priyanshi stayed back with her grandparents. On Thursday, after the wedding, Arun was returning home with his wife and children. At 11 AM, on the flyover just before DPS School, a speeding Bolero (UP 82-Q-8382) hit the bike. Hearing the screams and cries from the accident, people from nearby came running to the spot. Bolero driver fled leaving the vehicle Seeing passersby approaching, the Bolero driver fled leaving the vehicle behind. On receiving information, Station In-charge Rajendra Kumar Rawat reached the spot with force, but by then Arun, Naitik and Diksha had died. Wife Seema was writhing in pain. Police took Seema to Puwayan CHC, where doctors also declared her dead. According to police, Arun Dhobi (35) had gone to his brother-in-law's wedding with his wife Seema (30), son Naitik (4) and daughter Diksha (10). They were returning home from there. Now only 12-year-old daughter Priyanshi is left in the family. She is in a terrible state crying. SP Saurabh Dixit said- A bike collided with a Bolero. The bike-riding husband-wife and two children died. The bodies have been sent for post-mortem. The absconding Bolero driver is being searched for. Former MLA Roshan Lal Verma said that our demand from the government is that the families of the deceased should be given compensation of 40 lakh rupees. So that the surviving daughter in the family can be educated and married.

stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Mojtaba Khamenei says Iran will protect its ‘nuclear, missile capabilities’ Iranians view the country’s nuclear and missile capabilities “as their national capital and will guard them like water, land, and air borders”, Mojtaba Khamenei said. 2. BJP first choice on 31 of 46 Muslim-dominated seats in Bhaskar’s survey Muslims remain a major factor in Uttar Pradesh politics, accounting for around 19% of the state’s population. There are 46 Assembly seats where the Muslim population ranges between 30% and 60%. Of these, 24 are currently held by Bharatiya Janata Party, 20 by Samajwadi Party, and one each by Apna Dal (Sonelal) and Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party. 3. Become Amitabh Bachchan’s neighbour for ₹7 crore: Is Big B an Ayodhya resident or just an investor? In a video, Amitabh Bachchan calls himself a resident of Ayodhya. Reports say he recently bought a third property there, as nearby land prices surge and buyers pay up to ₹10 lakh extra to be his ‘neighbour’. 4. SC says ‘Remove abortion time limit for rape victims’ The Supreme Court on Thursday refused to hear a petition challenging the decision to terminate the 30-week pregnancy of a 15-year-old rape victim. The court said that a minor cannot be forced to become a mother, and in such cases, the decision should be that of the victim. 5. Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak alleges Samajwadi Party attempted to kill Mayawati A stormy special session of the Uttar Pradesh legislature witnessed sharp political attacks on Thursday, with Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath targeting the Samajwadi Party (SP), Congress, and the INDIA bloc over women’s issues and past incidents. 6. UP storm leaves 14 dead : IMD issues alert for 68 cities Weather conditions across Uttar Pradesh have changed dramatically, with storms and rainfall interrupting the ongoing heatwave and scorching temperatures. Cloud cover has spread across the state, with intermittent sunshine. 7. ISC, ICSE 2026 results out, 99% passing rate in Class 12th The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examination, i.e., CISCE, has released the results for ICSE Class 10th and ISC 12th exams. 98.18% students passed in CISCE 10th. 8. Non-bailable warrant issued against Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar The MP-MLA court in Mau has issued a non-bailable warrant against Cabinet Minister Omprakash Rajbhar. OP Rajbhar was not appearing in court in a case of threatening BJP leaders. The court took a strict stance on this. The next hearing of the case has been scheduled for May 16. 9. Triple murder accused birthday boy Jeetu Saini killed in encounter Days after a birthday party in Bulandshahr ended in a triple murder over a dispute involving cake-smearing, police on Thursday killed the main accused, Jeetu Saini, in an encounter. Jeetu was accused of shooting dead 3 relatives of a BJP councillor at a gym in Khurja before fleeing. A reward of Rs 50,000 had been announced on him. Jeetu was hit by three bullets in the exchange of fire. Police took him to the district hospital, where he died during treatment. 10. Mars has air…but deadly', says NASA NASA has confirmed that Mars does have an atmosphere. However, the real question is far more serious: could a human survive even a single breath on the Red Planet?
