stories.title: Why Japan is recruiting bodybuilders and MMA fighters for elderly care
stories.summary: Japan's aging population is leading care providers to recruit physically strong individuals, including bodybuilders and athletes, to assist with demanding tasks like lifting and mobility support. This innovative approach aims to address labor shortages in the care sector and make the profession more appealing to younger workers by highlighting its active nature.

stories.title: Donald Trump to get Nobel Peace Prize in 2026? Committee says 287 candidates shortlisted
stories.summary: Over 287 candidates, including Donald Trump, are vying for the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. The Norwegian Nobel Committee Secretary noted significant renewal among nominees, emphasizing the prize's enduring relevance amidst global conflicts. While nominations are confidential, leaders from Cambodia, Israel, and Pakistan have reportedly put Trump forward, though this doesn't guarantee an endorsement.

stories.title: US tightens visa rules, requires applicants to declare no persecution concerns in home country
stories.summary: US embassies now require nonimmigrant visa applicants to declare they don't fear persecution back home. This new rule, aimed at preventing asylum claims upon arrival, asks applicants if they've faced harm or fear it upon return. Experts warn this could force individuals into dangerous migration routes, jeopardizing their safety and families.

stories.title: Forget Ronaldo: João Cancelo set for historic record no player has ever achieved if Barca win La Liga
stories.summary: João Cancelo is on the brink of a unique European football milestone, with a potential La Liga title at Barcelona set to make him the first player to win four of Europe’s “Big Five” leagues. Having already lifted trophies in Italy, England and Germany, the achievement would surpass Cristiano Ronaldo’s cross-league record and underline Cancelo’s unusual, globe-spanning career path.

stories.title: Machines take charge: China to deploy 8,500 robots in $1B push to automate its power grid
stories.summary: China is investing $1 billion in approximately 8,500 robots for its national power grid. These machines, including robot dogs and those with robotic arms, will enhance inspection and maintenance in challenging environments. This move aims to boost efficiency, safety, and reliability in electricity delivery, while also advancing China's AI and robotics ambitions.

stories.title: MP boat mishap: cruise capsizes in Jabalpur, 4 killed, rescue ops on
stories.summary: Tragedy struck in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, as a cruise boat capsized in Bargi Dam, resulting in four fatalities. Officials confirmed that while 15 individuals have been rescued, search operations continue for 12 still missing. Rescue teams are actively working to locate all passengers following the devastating incident.

stories.title: 'They call Trump Nazi, Hitler & still attend': Erika Kirk hits out at journalists for 'ultimate hypocrisy' at White House dinner
stories.summary: Erika Kirk, CEO of Turning Point USA, criticized journalists for labeling President Trump with extreme terms while attending the White House Correspondents' Dinner. She attended to confront media over coverage of her and her late husband, Charlie Kirk, who was murdered in 2025. Kirk linked the attempted White House shooting to a climate of dehumanization fueled by media narratives.

stories.title: ‘No place in Gulf, except at bottom of its waters’: Iran’s Khamenei slams ‘Great Satan’ US, rejects nuclear curbs
stories.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei declared Iran's nuclear and missile capabilities non-negotiable, calling the US the "Great Satan" and asserting that foreigners have no place in the Persian Gulf. He emphasized that Iran's technological and military assets are national treasures to be protected by its population.

stories.title: Today's Chanakya exit poll: Mamata set to lose Bengal, status quo in Assam and Tamil Nadu; tight UDF–LDF race in Kerala
stories.summary: Today's Chanakya exit polls predict a landslide victory for the BJP in Assam, indicating a second term for Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma. In Kerala, the projections show a close contest between the incumbent LDF and the UDF, with the BJP expected to secure a few seats. Projections for West Bengal and Tamil Nadu are still awaited.

stories.title: ‘Iron Man’ Rodtang suffers rare second KO loss in retirement clash with fighter he previously beat in 80 secs
stories.summary: Takeru Segawa ended his career with a fifth-round stoppage of Rodtang “Iron Man” Jitmuangnon at ONE Samurai 1, claiming the interim flyweight kickboxing world title. The win avenged his 80-second knockout loss a year earlier, capping a 46–5 career. The bout saw Takeru overcome early pressure before dropping and finishing Rodtang in a dramatic reversal.

stories.summary: UAE motorists will face higher fuel costs in May 2026 as petrol prices see another significant increase. This marks the third consecutive monthly hike, driven by global oil market instability and geopolitical tensions. The latest revisions mean higher expenses for daily commutes and businesses reliant on transportation.

stories.title: Iran at UN accuses US of nuclear double standards, misuse of NPT platform
stories.summary: Iran's UN mission accused the US of misrepresenting its nuclear program at a review conference, deflecting from Washington's own violations. Tehran insists its enriched uranium is IAEA-supervised, with no diversion. Meanwhile, Iran's envoy warned that regional stability hinges on ending aggression and respecting its sovereignty, urging the UN Security Council to intervene amidst escalating tensions.

stories.title: India among worst-hit as hepatitis deaths stay high despite global gains: WHO report
stories.summary: India faces a significant hepatitis burden, contributing to a high number of global deaths. Despite progress in reducing infections, the world is off track to meet 2030 elimination targets due to gaps in vaccination, screening, and treatment access. Viral hepatitis remains a major public health threat.

This move by IGNOU, now redesignated as Clinical Cardio Physician (Non-Invasive), aims to address the critical shortage of cardiology specialists in underserved regions and bridge the urban-rural healthcare gap.

stories.title: 'Strait of Trump': US President shares new map naming Hormuz after himself

stories.title: 'Imagine the pain, humiliation': Supreme Court urges Centre to allow abortion beyond 20 weeks for rape survivors
stories.summary: The Supreme Court urged the Centre to consider amending laws to allow rape survivors to terminate pregnancies beyond 20 weeks, emphasizing no time limit in such cases. stories.title: I-PAC co-founder and director Vinesh Chandela gets bail in money laundering case
stories.summary: I-PAC director Vinesh Chandela has been granted bail by a Delhi court in a money laundering case. stories.summary: Influencer Aleksandra Vasilevna Mendoza has filed a lawsuit against streamer Clavicular, real name Braden Peters, alleging abuse, fraud, and emotional harm. stories.summary: Sebastian Sawe’s record-breaking London Marathon run has delivered a life-changing payday, with prize money and bonuses pushing his earnings toward seven figures. stories.title: Trump halts speech in awkward moment to praise Rory McIlroy’s Masters win at White House dinner
stories.summary: At a White House state dinner, Donald Trump broke from his prepared speech to publicly praise Rory McIlroy’s Masters triumph, creating an unscripted moment that briefly disrupted the evening’s formal tone. stories.summary: Vice President JD Vance described the chaotic scene at the White House Correspondents' Association Dinner after a suspected armed man allegedly attempted to breach security and target President Trump. Vance recounted hearing unclear noises and seeing people ducking under tables before a security agent instructed him to leave.

stories.title: Who is Amy Beck? Noah Beck’s mother suspended after TikTok video resurfaces amid Haley Beck controversy
stories.summary: Amy Beck, mother of Noah Beck, was placed on leave from her Arizona teaching job after an old TikTok video resurfaced online. The clip sparked strong reactions from parents and led to a school investigation. The case has gained more attention due to ongoing issues involving her daughter Haley Beck, with no final decision yet announced.

stories.title: The King of Comedy: How Charles III used humour to reprimand Donald Trump in the US Congress
stories.summary: There is, rather conveniently, an actual novel called The Two Georges which imagines a world in which George Washington and King George III settle their differences and the American Revolution never happens. In that version of history, America remains within the British system, the empire adapts, and everyone carries on with a slightly different flag and a great deal more politeness. Charles’s joke worked because it gestured at that absurd possibility, only to return the room to reality. The revolution did happen. The king did lose. The republic did win. The story was settled.

stories.title: White House dinner attack: Man charged in Trump assassination bid took photo with knife before assault
stories.summary: A California man, Cole Allen, is accused of attempting to assassinate President Trump at the White House Correspondents' Association dinner. Prosecutors revealed he photographed himself armed before the attack, which involved firing a shotgun at security. Allen, who had planned his actions, faces multiple charges.

stories.title: After giving away $26 billion in philanthropy, MacKenzie Scott’s wealth remains largely unchanged — here's why
stories.summary: MacKenzie Scott has donated over $26 billion since 2019, yet remains extremely wealthy because her fortune is tied to Amazon stock. As share values rise, her wealth continues to grow, allowing her to give at an unprecedented scale without a proportional decline in net worth.
